: “It’s deeply troubling that anyone would use this incident, which the Chabad movement at large has strongly condemned, to draw inappropriate and false comparisons to Hamas tunnels in Gaza or propagate age-old antisemitic conspiracy theories, such as Jews are involved in human trafficking or organ harvesting”. [2]


Given its relatively low profile, you might well assume that, whatever it is up to, Chabad is just a religious sect and plays no real and serious role on a world political stage presented to us as thoroughly secular.


If so, you are gravely mistaken, as Pierre Hillard expertly explains in his book

Comprendre l’empire loubavitch

 (‘Understanding the Lubavitch empire’).


He says that, in fact, the organisation wields global influence at the highest levels and is playing “an absolutely decisive role in the course of human history”. [3]


Hillard traces the Chabad story back to the time of Jesus who, from his own Christian perspective, was the Messiah whose coming had been predicted in biblical Judaism.


But he says that in the centuries before Jesus’s birth, Jewish religious commentary had been predicting “a warrior Messiah, not a suffering one, acting in the sole interests of the Jewish world, which would claim primacy over all the peoples of the earth”. [4]


“This misinterpretation of sacred texts led the Jewish elites, with some exceptions such as Nicodemus, not to recognise Christ as the logical fulfilment of all the prophetic announcements”. [5]


Subsequently, their Temple in Jerusalem was destroyed by the Romans and they were scattered around the place, whether in Rome, Alexandria or Babylon.


They were, of course, still waiting for the “real” Messiah, or

Moshiach

, to turn up and this was still the warrior version, not the suffering one.


In fact, explains Hillard, the roles are flipped in comparison to the Christian outlook. In Jewish teaching, it is not the Messiah who suffers for the people of the whole world, but the Jewish people who suffer in order to bring the Messiah who will give them control over the whole world.


Therefore, as the Israeli scholar Gershom Scholem set out, the Jewish idea of redemption is not beyond time, as Christians see it, but very physically part of history – specifically Jewish history. [6]


Hillard explains that in the early years of Christianity the rabbinical world found itself confronted with a new entity becoming increasingly important in the Roman empire, which was persuading not just pagans but also Jews to convert to its faith.


Faced with the prospect of their flock joining, and further strengthening, this rival religion, they put together two new books of rabbinic commentary aimed at seeing off the threat – the Jerusalem Talmud and the Babylonian Talmud.


“These texts were written between the first and the sixth centuries and constituted the religious, political and civil code of the rabbinic synagogue. Aimed at retaining the Jewish world, but also at persuading it to wait patiently for the Messiah, these two works are violently anti-Christian”. [7]


From a Talmudic perspective, Jesus had betrayed Moses’ teaching and was consequently condemned to boil for ever in excrement. [8]


Among countless Jewish sources, Hillard quotes rabbi Abraham Cohen’s description of the Talmudic judeo-supremacism that is at the heart of Chabad Lubavitch’s worldview.


“Nothing is more natural, in a literature composed by Jews for Jews, than the exceptional pre-eminence given to the people of Israel. The inhabitants of the world can effectively be divided between Israel and the other nations considered as one block.


“This is obviously a biblical doctrine, but the rabbis have amplified it infinitely. Everywhere the Talmud explicitly insists on the close and unique kinship that exists between God and His people.


“The relationship that unites Israel to God is so intimate that the way in which Israel is treated on earth has repercussions for God in heaven… ‘He who hates Israel is …

author: Emma Honeybun
title: Advocacy group travelling around James Bay to raise awareness of Ring of Fire
content:
A family from Northern Ontario is documenting a remote bay to raise awareness of what large-scale mining would do to the area and its biodiversity.


Jeronimo Kataquapit, a 21-year-old from Attawapiskat First Nation, is the founder of

Here We Stand

, a grassroots youth advocacy group which focuses on treaty rights and the environment south of the Hudson Bay.


On Aug. 21, Kataquapit announced that he and his parents and cousin, along with the family’s Labrador Retriever, Gunner, had kicked off a lengthy journey into James Bay, a remote, 68,300-square-kilometre section of the south bank of the Hudson Bay, near where Attawapiskat First Nation is located.


The journey, which was meant to document and broadcast the land and its several rivers to a social media audience, was done in direct response to the ongoing development of a road network to allow for mining in Ontario’s Ring of Fire.


“You can call this place many things, from the peatlands to the breathing lands, to the last frontier, or a sanctuary for all the biodiversity that calls this place home, but one thing I know it is for certain, is that it’s home,” Kataquapit said, in an update posted to social media.


“For me, I could stand here all day long, telling you all the reasons why we need to protect a place like this, but the first and only reason I need to protect this place, is because it’s home, and it’s who I am, and it’s where I belong,” he continued. “It will continue to be who I am and what I protect in the future.”


Gunner watches his owners boat toward the Ekwan River. Photo: Jeronimo Kataquapit/Facebook.


The Ring of Fire is a mineral-rich area of the bay, approximately 5,000-square-kilometres in size. According to the Government of Ontario, it contains “one of the most promising mineral development opportunities in the world.”


A few days after Kataquapit’s journey began, on Monday, Aug. 24,

Ontario announced

 the ground-breaking of a 107-kilometre, all-season road into the area.


Currently, the Ring of Fire is only accessible by air or winter ice roads for a “brief window” each year, according to the province.


The gravel road, proposed by Webequie First Nation, would allow for longer and simpler access to the natural resources there, which, according to Ontario, will “help unlock the vast economic potential of critical minerals in the region.”


Thus, the province stated, would “add $22 billion to Ontario’s economy, create 70,000 good-paying jobs, strengthen domestic supply chains and support long-term economic growth and prosperity for First Nations communities and northern Ontario.”


Alongside Webequie, the road is also being built in collaboration with Aroland and Marten Falls First Nations, which signed community partnership agreements in October and November 2025, respectively.


However, several other First Nations are speaking out about the environmental detriment this would have on the area.


A map of the Ring of Fire in northern Ontario.


APTN News

recently reported

 that on July 23, advocacy group

Friends of the Attawapiskat River

 filed a request for a judicial review of the project, saying that Ottawa’s own

federal impact assessment

 found that the road would cause “significant” damage to the environment and Indigenous rights.


“Where I call home, is one of the last remaining pristine, intact, and vast ecosystems left on the planet,” Kataquapit stated, in the journey’s announcement. “They are called the peatlands and are known to us as the breathing lands of Mother Earth. They store billions upon billions of tons of carbon and sequester millions of tons each year.


“I want people to see that what happens here, in the peatlands where the Ring of Fire is proposed, is inherently connected to the life of the Bay, our life, our health.”


Here We Stand has also spoken out against Bill 5, the

Protect Ontario by Unleashing our Economy Act

, and Bill C-5, the

One Canadian Economy Act

,

 which were both passed in June 2025.


Bill 5

 allows for Ontario to create ‘special economic zones,’ which, according to legislation, means the provincial government has the authority to exempt large-scale projects being built in these zones from regulations under other bills such as the

Ontario Heritage Act

 and the E

nvironmental Assessment Act

, among others.


According to

Chiefs of Ontario

, the bill “significantly weakens environmental protections, reduces oversight of mining and development projects, and limits …

author: Unknown
title: Foça'da "Barış ve Ekoloji" için belgesel film günleri başlıyor
content:
İzmir – Barışa her geçen gün daha fazla ihtiyaç duyulan günlerde Foça Barış Kadınları, 1 Eylül Barış gününde, ‘’Barış ve Ekoloji’’ temalı belgesel gösterimi ve söyleşiler düzenliyor.

Bu yıl 3. kez düzenlenecek olan etkinlikte, Şarap Rengi Deniz, Seva/Birlikte, Kaz Dağları Talanı ve Habap Çeşmeleri belgeselleri gösterilecek. Barış etkinliklerinde, geçtiğimiz Haziran ayında yaşama veda eden kadın, insan hakları ve barış savunucusu, Kıbrıslı gazeteci ve yazar Sevgül Uludağ ile cinayet sonucu hayatını kaybeden çevre savunucusu, bağımsız gazeteci, yönetmen Hakan Tosun anılacak.

Etkinliğin ilk gününde, çatışmalı ortamın sonucu büyük acıların yaşandığı Kıbrıs’ta, Türk-Rum ayırt etmeden kayıpların peşine düşen kadın, barış ve insan hakları savunucusu Sevgül Uludağ’ın hayatı ve mücadelesi anlatılacak. Barış ve birlikteliğe adadığı hayatından kesitler sunularak Kıbrıs’ta iki toplum arasında kardeşlik ve barışın kurulması çabalarına tanık olunacak.

Etkinlik Nefin Dinç’in yönetmenliğini yaptığı ve Marmara’dan Akdeniz’e uzanan kirliliği ve biyoçeşitliliğin yok oluşunu konu alan ‘’Şarap Rengi Deniz’’ ile devam edecek. Günün son gösterimi elli binden fazla can kaybının yaşandığı 6 Şubat depremi sonrası Antakya’da kadın, çocuk ve gençlerin dayanışmalarını, cesaret ve umut hikayelerini konu alan "Seva" belgeseli. Filmin ardından yönetmen Nesime Karateke ile bir söyleşi gerçekleştirilecek.

Etkinliğin ikinci gününde evine giderken öldürülen çevre savunucusu ve gazeteci Hakan Tosun’un çektiği ‘’Kaz Dağları Talanı’’ belgeseli gösteriminin ardından kardeşi Özlem Tosun ile bir söyleşi gerçekleşecek. Söyleşide, Hakan Tosun cinayeti ile ilgili dava süreci dinleyicilerle birlikte masaya yatırılacak.

Söyleşinin ardından, projesi Hrant Dink Vakfı ve Fethiye Çetin'e ait olan, yönetmenliğini Dilek Aydın’ın üstlendiği, Habap Çeşmeleri belgeseli izleyiciyle buluşacak. Belgesel, Fethiye Çetin’in bir sırrını ve şimdiki adı Ekinözü olan Habap köyünde restorasyonu yapılan çeşmelerin hikayesini anlatıyor.

İzleyicilerle buluşacak belgeseller:

Yönetmen Nefin Dinç'in, kendine özgü sade ve çarpıcı anlatımıyla Marmara Deniz'inden Akdeniz'e uzanan kirliliğe, Akdeniz'deki biyoçeşitliliğin yok oluşuna odaklanan uluslararası ödüllü belgeseli.

Yönetmenliğini Nesime Karateke'nin üstlendiği, 6 Şubat 2023 depremlerinin ardından Antakya'da yaşanan yıkımı, yas sürecini ve dayanışmayla yeniden filizlenen hayatı konu alıyor.

Dünyanın en yüksek oksijen oranına sahip bölgelerinden biri olan Kaz Dağları'nın, ekonomik rant, madencilik faaliyetleri ve altın-bakır arama projeleri uğruna uğradığı büyük ekolojik yıkımı ve buna karşı yürütülen toplumsal direnişi konu alıyor.

Elazığ'ın Kovancılar ilçesindeki 400 yıllık tarihi çeşmelerin onarımı ve hatırlama süreci... Fethiye Çetin'in “Anneannem” adlı kitabında çocukluk anılarını anlattığı, kökle ve geçmişteki yaşamla doğrudan bağ kurmasını ele alıyor. Habap köyünde ailesiyle yaşayan mutlu bir kız çocuğu olan Heranuş’un isminin Seher’e, köyünün ise Ekinözü’ne dönüşmesini aktarıyor.

Etkinlikler 1–2 Eylül 2026 tarihlerinde, saat 19:00'da Foça Reha Midilli Kültür Merkezi'nde ücretsiz olarak gerçekleştirilecek.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: IRGC shelling causes wildfire in Shaho protected area
content:
The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has shelled protected areas of Shaho Mountain in Kamyaran County, Kurdistan Province, causing a widespread wildfire that remains active.


The Kurdistan Human Rights Network (KHRN) has reported that in recent days, IRGC forces told residents of villages around the mountain that access to the area would be prohibited for several days.


The forces then shelled the mountain, setting fire to a large part of the protected area.


Videos received by KHRN show the extent of the wildfire. IRGC forces have prevented environmental activists and local residents from entering the area to contain the blaze.


The Shaho and Kusalan protected area covers 57,236 hectares between the cities of Sarvabad, Ravansar, Paveh, Marivan and Kamyaran, near the border with the Kurdistan Region of Iraq.


It was designated a protected area under the management of Iran’s Department of Environment in 2009, pursuant to Resolution 303 of the Supreme Council for the Environment.


Environmental activists said the IRGC had built several military bases in the protected area since 2007, under the pretext of countering the presence of forces affiliated with Kurdish opposition parties.


Large parts of the area catch fire each year during security exercises.


Despite protests by environmental activists, extensive areas of pasture and forest have been destroyed during the construction of military bases and roads.


IRGC forces also deliberately set fire each year to pastures and forests around military installations, claiming this is intended to “prevent Kurdish opposition party forces from using vegetation cover to carry out attacks.”

author: Miriam Lafontaine
title: Coast Guard spills 200 litres of fuel from vessel on Baker Lake
content:
A fuel spill reported in Baker Lake on Tuesday morning has resulted in residents temporarily being cut off from their water supply.


The Canadian Coast Guard reported the spill, which involved a sea vessel, to the territory’s environmental authorities just before 7 a.m. on Tuesday, according to coast guard’s report in the N.W.T. and Nunavut spill database.


Approximately 200 litres of petroleum fuel spilled in the lake just northwest of Christopher Island and impacted 1,500 square metres of the lake’s surface area, according to the database.

The cause of the spill is not yet known.


Nunavut’s Department of Transportation and Infrastructure informed residents about the spill on Wednesday through a public service announcement. 


The Department of Health ordered a temporary shut down of the community’s water treatment plant while authorities determined the seriousness of the spill. According to the public service announcement, drinking water access was restored after the department determined the water was safe to drink. 


That department will also continue to monitor the quality of water in the area, said the public service announcement.


There have been a number of spills in Baker Lake over the past several months. In April 2025, about 100 litres spilled after a fuel truck operator

fell asleep

 while filling his truck.


A

diesel spill in the hamlet

 in June was estimated to be between 600 and 1,000 litres.


Nunatsiaq News is still waiting on comment from the Canadian Coast Guard and Nunavut’s Department of Infrastructure to learn more about the incident.

author: Kelsie kilawna
title: A syilx Youth’s fight to save her horses, and the thread that cannot burn
content:
Sienna Belanger, 25, walks toward the smoke to turn on the water at her mother’s barn as the Bradley Creek wildfire approaches her family’s property on the Okanagan Indian Band, Aug. 1. Photo by Mariel Belanger


This story is co-published

with The Narwhal

.


When the fire came to the Okanagan Indian Band, Sienna Belanger’s first instinct was to catch her horses.


Winds had reached 115 km/h, with sustained speeds of 80 km/h, according to the BC Wildfire Service. Six-foot-tall flames ripped through the grassland.


“I only managed to get one of my horses,” she said. “Then we just opened up the gate and ran with them down to our bottom field. They got loose. All I could do was hope and pray.”


Sienna did not know the syilx word qwilmiʔst on August 1 when the Bradley Creek wildfire came, but she lived it. The teaching describes a person who pulls together their physical skills, their sharpest thinking, their deepest intuition, and their spiritual awareness and acts without hesitation. 


It is what the Old People call on when facing anything serious. To hold back part of yourself is to risk everything. To give your whole self is how you meet the unknown.


As the fire grew closer, the flames were everywhere. Sienna ran through the smoke, through the flames, to turn on the water at her mother’s barn. 


She started dousing the flames. She does not remember making the decision, but she remembers her body moving.


“It was just like that adrenaline moment where you do something or you freeze, and my loved ones froze, and I just couldn’t in that moment myself not do anything,” she said. 


“I just felt like a different switch turned on, and I was like, ‘Okay, there are things to do, things I need to organize.'”


She was not thinking or hesitating, she was qwilmiʔst. All of herself was in motion.


A land worker, a horsewoman, a dreamer


Sienna has been in her home on the Okanagan Indian Band since the fire came over the hill on Aug. 1. She and her neighbours at Abel Cove were under evacuation order, but with such a short time to leave, they chose to stay.


Her Papa had always been intentional about who lived in this community.


“My papa did really good in picking his people for his community,” Sienna says. “He chose people that would be helpful, that would be a good contribution to his family and an extension. And so all of these families who have stayed have been people who I’ve known my whole life.”


Even though he’s gone, she says, his efforts are still here. The people he chose knew how to fight fire. They knew how to hold their ground.


So, with no time to flee, or to pack, it was just Sienna,  the fire, the wind, and her horses.


The Bradley Creek wildfire has destroyed or damaged an estimated 245 structures on Okanagan Indian Band land, according to a

formal assessment

 by Canada Task Force 1 . The team examined 513 structures over three days. As of Aug. 19, the fire remains classified as “being held,” with over 100 firefighters and six helicopters still working the perimeter.


The aircraft have not stopped.


For at least two weeks, there has been a constant presence of blades chopping, of shadows of helicopters crossing the sky, of the distant rumble of bombers dropping fire retardant on the hillside above her mother’s place and her grandmother’s house at the beach.


Sienna, 25, is a syilx sqilx’w youth born and raised at the Okanagan Indian Band. Her nsyilxcen name is xixʷutm, a name she carries from her great-granny Mary.


Sienna Belanger and her mother, Mariel Belanger own and operate

Studio Síspl̓k

. The creative space on Okanagan Indian Band welcomes community organizations, schools, and wellness programs for workshops that bring together storytelling, visual arts, land-based learning, food forest knowledge sharing and n’syilxcen language. It’s the kind of work she’s been doing for years—creek rehabilitation, forest restoration, plant identification, seed harvesting—work that has always been about connection. 


For years, Sienna had been shaping the land around her. She planted over a hundred plants on ten acres of her family’s property—a food forest she dreamed would one day feed her people. When the fire came, it took most of it. But not all. Photos submitted by Sienna Belanger


That work is rooted in the

nsisúlaʔxʷ Food Forest Project

, a living, land-based classroom and gathering place where Siennas food plants, medicines, and community are able to grow in kinship with one another …

author: Sare Frabes
title: El arte como resistencia y preludio a la llegada del EZLN a la capital de México
content:
Fotos por Juana Machetes / Radio Zapatista

El Ejercito Zapatista de Liberación Nacional (EZLN) ha desplegado en todo el mes de agosto de 2026 un vasto programa cultural en distintas sedes en Chiapas, como acto de resistencia ante el "acoso sistemático a la creación artística", donde reunió a figuras como Luis de Tavira, Dolores Heredia y Marina de Tavira. Este preludio ha sido la antesala de la próxima histórica movilización zapatista hacia la Ciudad de México en diciembre, donde 1,111 rebeldes celebrarán su 33 aniversario en Ciudad de México y se reunirán con colectivos de búsqueda de desaparecidos (más de 130,000 en el país).

En el arranque de las diversas actividades relacionadas con el arte y la cultura, el capitán Marcos criticó el impacto de la inteligencia artificial y las redes sociales, tomando a la fotografía como ejemplo, señalando que "la cultura visual en boga privilegia la velocidad y la cantidad" y que "con la IA ni siquiera necesitas la foto".

El capitán recordó la enseñanza del fallecido subcomandante Marcos, "Podrán cambiar los lentes, pero nunca la mirada", subrayando que la mirada atenta y profunda es un acto de resistencia irrenunciable ante las tecnologías de dominación.

Entre las diversas actividades, el jueves 20 de agosto se estrenó la obra teatral "El Común y el día después", con más de 200 participantes, que escenifica la apuesta zapatista por una organización colectiva anticapitalista y antipatriarcal. La obra se extendió a dos funciones más (27 y 28 de agosto), transmitidas desde el Caracol Jacinto Canek.

El mes de agosto ha sido diseñado como un gran encuentro de artes y rebeldías, con actividades desde el 1 de agosto en el Semillero Comandanta Ramona, presentaciones hasta el 16, continúo en San Cristóbal de las Casas el 17, y finaliza en el Caracol Jacinto Canek hasta el día 30 de agosto, a cargo del capitán Marcos.

Este despliegue cultural en el Centro Indígena de Capacitación Integral (CIDECI) y en los Caracoles funciona como algo más que un festival. Es el preludio de la masiva movilización zapatista hacia la Ciudad de México en diciembre próximo, cuando una delegación de aproximadamente 1,111 integrantes del EZLN establecerá su base en la capital para conmemorar el 33 aniversario de su levantamiento armado, abrazar la causa de los colectivos de madres buscadoras y relanzar el capítulo nacional de la “Gira por la Vida”.

Mientras en Chiapas se comparten las diversas formas de hacer arte y cultura, en la Ciudad de México ya se afinan los preparativos para recibir a la comitiva zapatista. El sábado 29 de agosto a las 16 horas, la Comunidad Indígena Otomí residente en la CDMX ha convocado a la Segunda Reunión de Organización y Coordinación para recibir a los zapatistas, a realizarse en la Casa de los Pueblos y Comunidades Indígenas “Samir Flores Soberanes” (Av. México-Coyoacán 343, Col. Xoco, Benito Juárez), el mismo espacio que alojará a la delegación zapatista durante su estancia.

La reunión tiene como objetivo organizar las actividades previas a la llegada del grupo rebelde, asumiendo que “la recepción zapatista es y será colectiva y en común”.

De la misma forma, en la máxima casa de estudios, en la Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México (UNAM) ya se han comenzado a convocar las primeras reuniones entre estudiantes, académicos y trabajadores. Como es el caso de la Asamblea Interuniversitaria, que se realizará este 28 de agosto, a las 16:00 horas, en el Anfiteatro de la Facultad de Ciencias Políticas y Sociales (FCPyS), para organizar el recibimiento de la delegación zapatista.

Aún están por definirse más reuniones y asambleas para concretar los preparativos y poder recibir a los 1111 zapatistas. Uno de sus objetivos es poder reunirse con colectivos de familiares de personas desaparecidas para endurecer y respaldar su causa.

author: Kay Pacha / Equipo Pueblos Originarios del SERPAJ
title: Masivo y contundente apoyo a las comunidades Quintriqueo y Melo
content:
En la semana que pasó creo que todo el país estaba en conocimiento de la situación por la que atravesaron y aún lo siguen haciendo, las Comunidades Mapuche Quintriqueo y Melo, en la Provincia de Neuquén, ya que su desalojo estaba previsto para el día 20 de agosto.  Pero como una medida artera, ésta se adelantó para el 19 y llegaron a desalojar un parte del Lof Quintriqueo.


https://argentina.indymedia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Quintriqueo-y-Melo.mp3


https://argentina.indymedia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Quintriqueo-y-Melo.mp3


Descargar audio


Amenazaron al Lof Melo, pero no llegaron a concretar el desalojo, por lo menos hasta el cierre de esta edición.


Y más allá de la indignación que nos causó esta medida inconstitucional, ya que entre otras cosas la causa estaba cerrada y ni siquiera el abogado de la comunidad podía verla, lo que nos causó mucha satisfacción, fue la enorme, enorme, cantidad de solidaridad recibida de todas comunidades, organizaciones indígenas, sociales, políticas, de derechos humanos, educativas, etc., no solo de la provincia, sino también de todas partes del país.


Esto, además del “caravanazo” llevado adelante el día sábado 22, desde Bariloche y desde Villa La Angostura. Se calcula que había cerca de 100 vehículos desde Bariloche y más de 200 desde Villa La Angostura. Dicen que pasaron por el resguardo más de 1.000 personas en las horas que duró la actividad.


Esto fue una demostración de apoyo popular nunca antes vista, lo que nos da mucho ánimo, porque al margen de la convocatoria que hubo a través de distintos medios y por las redes, significa que mucha gente ya no tolera estas injusticias y decide participar de esta forma.  Y la verdad que esto ya es un triunfo, lograr tanta participación. Consideramos que el compromiso y la participación popular son dos pilares importantes para tratar de cambiar esta tremenda e injusta realidad que estamos viviendo.


Y bueno, entonces vamos a escuchar a lxs lonkos Lucas Melo y Amancay Quintriqueo, comentando sus sentimientos en estos momentos de tanta tensión. Agradecemos a quienes hicieron estos videos, que la verdad han dado tantas vueltas, que ya no sabemos al fin quiénes los hicieron.


El Micro Kay Pacha se realiza con el apoyo de la organización Otto per Mille-Chiessa Valdense.


La entrada

Masivo y contundente apoyo a las comunidades Quintriqueo y Melo

 se publicó primero en

Indymedia Argentina Centro de Medios Independientes (( i ))

.

author: anred
title: Vic Núñez Fernández: “es impactante ver el aparato del poder puesto a favor de la mentira”
content:
Vic junto a las defensoras públicas Verónica Ponce y Laura Carpinetti. Foto: Roxana Sposaro.


El 13 de agosto, la Justicia de la provincia de Chubut, con el juez Jorge Criado a cargo, decidió extender por un año la investigación contra “Vic” Núñez Fernández, a pedido de los fiscales María Bottini e Ismael Cerda. A Núñez Fernández se le atribuye la presunta coautoría en el incendio de maquinarias de la Estancia Amancay, en Trevelin, así como su participación en una supuesta “asociación ilícita”. Sin embargo, en un año y medio de proceso, la fiscalía no ha presentado pruebas concretas en su contra.

Por Infoterritorial.


El hecho investigado, un ataque incendiario a las máquinas de la localidad cordillerana, ocurrió el 19 de enero de 2025 días después del desalojo del Lof Pailako, en las cercanías del Parque Nacional Los Alerces. Tres semanas más tarde, la respuesta estatal no se hizo esperar: fuerzas provinciales y federales desplegaron más de una decena de 

allanamientos simultáneos contra comunidades Mapuche-Tehuelche de la cordillera

 en Chubut. Violando la garantía de presunción de inocencia y desplegando todo su poder mediático, funcionarios nacionales y provinciales celebraron el despliegue del Comando Unificado y condenaron públicamente a integrantes de las comunidades.


Estos operativos se enmarcan a una narrativa que se repite cada verano: mientras la 

crisis climática y los incendios forestales

 devoran los bosques y pinares de la cordillera, el poder político y económico intenta buscar un chivo expiatorio en los pueblos Mapuche Tehuelche. Para las comunidades, 

la consolidación del modelo extractivista exige “territorios vacíos”, y, en este marco, la reivindicación identitaria y territorial representa un estorbo para los grandes intereses económicos

. Por eso, “se quiere imponer en el imaginario social la idea del mapuche terrorista”, denuncian.


En ese marco el Poder Judicial de la Provincia de Chubut sostiene la “causa Amancay”. Aunque

 se investiga a más de 60 personas del pueblo Mapuche Tehuelche

, Núñez Fernández es la única persona imputada. Transcurridos 18 meses, el Ministerio Público Fiscal sigue con las manos vacías, y aún no ha reunido pruebas que vinculen a Vic -ni ninguna de las personas que sufrieron los operativos- con el atentado incendiario.


Desvincular a Vic de la causa significaría admitir que toda la pirotecnia política, mediática y judicial fue un montaje carente de sustento.


Juez Jorge Criado. Foto: Roxana Sposaro.


Una acusación que se cae a pedazos


Durante la última audiencia,

 la defensora pública Valeria Ponce solicitó el sobreseimiento definitivo de Núñez Fernández 

y expuso el vacío de la acusación a través de datos demoledores como:


El vehículo equivocado:

 La hipótesis central se apoyaba en una camioneta Renault Kangoo propiedad de Núñez. Sin embargo, los peritajes sobre las cámaras de seguridad demostraron que el vehículo captado en la escena era un Fiat Fiorino.

La descarga de datos del GPS de la Kangoo 

(peritaje realizado por la firma Digisystem y aceptado por la propia Fiscalía) confirmó que el vehículo estaba en la localidad de Corcovado al momento del incendio. Múltiples testimonios ratificaron que Vic se encontraba allí participando de un encuentro de medicina ancestral.

La Fiscalía insiste en mantener el cargo de asociación ilícita

, una figura jurídica que exige legalmente un mínimo de tres integrantes. Sin embargo, la causa tiene solo una imputada.


Pese a la contundencia de estos elementos, la fiscalía justificó la prórroga argumentando medidas pendientes tan débiles como la espera de datos por parte de la red social Meta -respuestas que raramente llegan a la justicia local- o peritajes de celulares pendientes. Aceptando este argumento, el 

juez Jorge Criado -quien participó de forma virtual- descartó los elementos presentados por la defensa pública y le otorgó a la fiscalía 365 días más para intentar sostener lo insostenible.


Las verdaderas razones de la persecución


Para Vic, la criminalización de los integrantes de Pueblos Indígenas y de quienes los acompañan está relacionada con un 

reordenamiento geopolítico mundial que incluye la disputa por los bienes naturales.

 “Quieren utilizarlo para avanzar sobre los territorios indiscriminadamente; el 

proyecto de Ley de Inviolabilidad de la Propiedad Privada 

está en sintonía con este contexto. Y 

como no tienen razones, hablar de ‘asociación ilícita’ es una forma de apuntar a las …

author: Dulce Amor Rodriguez
title: EXPLAINER: Why mental health professionals want DepEd’s live shooter drill deferred
content:
Psychiatrists and child mental health specialists insist that preparedness and psychological well-being should not be treated as competing priorities.


MANILA — The Department of Education’s (DepEd) plans to conduct a nationwide simultaneous school safety drill for active attack incidents has drawn concern from mental health professionals, who warned that hyper-realistic active shooter simulations may cause psychological harm to learners while offering little evidence that they improve school safety.


In a

joint statement

 released on August 22, the Philippine Psychiatric Association (PPA) and the Philippine Society for Child and Adolescent Psychiatry (PSCAP) called for the deferment of any simulation of a live shooter attack drill, saying school preparedness must remain trauma-informed and evidence-based.


The two organizations stressed that they support efforts to make schools safe and resilient but argued that the methods used to prepare students and school personnel matter as much as the goal itself.


What prompted the call for deferment?


The statement came in response to a DepEd

memorandum

 dated August 12 directing schools nationwide to conduct a nationwide simultaneous school safety drill for active attack incidents.


The PPA and the PSCAP said active attack simulations differ significantly from routine drills for earthquakes, fires, and other emergencies.


The groups said schools regularly conduct disaster preparedness exercises because these activities teach practical responses to real emergencies without exposing learners to graphic or highly realistic depictions of violence.


They argued that live shooter simulations introduce a different level of psychological risk because they often recreate violent scenarios that place participants in situations resembling actual attacks.


According to the groups, these exercises can expose children and adolescents to fear, uncertainty, and distress that may linger long after the drill ends.


What does the evidence say?


Mental health professionals based their position on studies and recommendations from medical, educational, and safety organizations.


The National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine

reported

 in 2025 that available evidence remains insufficient to conclude that active shooter simulations improve safety outcomes.


The report also advised schools against using high-intensity drills and deceptive practices.


The PPA and the PSCAP cited a

large-scale study

 published in 2021 that analyzed 54 million social media posts from 114 schools in the United States.


Researchers found a 42 percent increase in language associated with stress and anxiety after shooter drills.


The same study documented a 39 percent increase in language associated with depression.


Researchers found that these effects remained evident for at least 90 days after the exercises.


The organizations also cited a 2020

policy statement

 from the American Academy of Pediatrics, which cautioned against involving children and adolescents in high-intensity crisis simulations.


The academy said schools should never rely on deception when conducting emergency preparedness exercises involving young people.


The groups also referenced guidance released this year by the National Association of School Psychologists, the National Association of School Resource Officers, the American Academy of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, and Safe and Sound Schools.


The guidance recommended banning hyper-realistic simulations, requiring advance notice before drills, and involving school mental health professionals in planning and implementation.


Why are children considered particularly vulnerable?


Mental health experts said children process fear and traumatic experiences differently from adults.


The PPA and the PSCAP warned that realistic simulations can trigger strong emotional reactions among learners, especially those who have previously experienced violence, abuse, displacement, disasters, or other traumatic events.


The organizations noted that some learners may also have disabilities, sensory-processing needs, or mental health conditions that make them more vulnerable to distress during highly immersive drills.


Mental health professionals argued that schools should avoid preparedness measures that inadvertently create psychological harm while attempting to prevent physical harm.


The groups emphasized that protecting learners requires balancing security …

author: Ashley Smith
title: When the Left Distances Itself From Black Lives Matter, Far Right Policies Win
content:
Alec Karakatsanis explains how both Republicans and Democrats have used the backlash to increase the powers of police.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

Just six years after millions of people across the country took part in racial justice uprisings after the police murders of George Floyd and Breonna Taylor, politicians and pundits of all stripes — from reactionaries like President Donald Trump to progressives like Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez — have turned against demands to decrease funding for police. Those demands were popularized over years of organizing from a broad popular movement against decades of unprecedented mass incarceration.

In this interview, Alec Karakatsanis explains the roots of the backlash, how both Republicans and Democrats have used it to increase the powers of police, and why it’s essential to rebuild the movement to fund communities, not cops. Karakatsanis is the founder and executive director of the Civil Rights Corps, an organization that has pioneered landmark litigation challenging systemic injustices in the punishment bureaucracy, author of the book, Copaganda: How the Police and Media Manipulate our News, and publisher of the Copaganda Newsletter.

This interview has been edited for length and clarity.

Ashley Smith: After the police murder of George Floyd, the U.S. exploded in protest, becoming the biggest wave of mass demonstrations in U.S. history with as many as an estimated 26 million people marching across the country. Republicans and Democrats launched a backlash against the movement. What have they argued and done?

Alec Karakatsanis: It’s important to underscore that it’s not just Republicans behind the backlash. It’s a bipartisan establishment assault on the movement that emerged in the decade before 2020. That struggle aimed to reduce the size and power of the punishment bureaucracy, the term I use to describe the institutions the government uses to repress people and the for-profit industries parasitic on them.

That bureaucracy’s role is to control and manage inequality, targeting the most oppressed in our society, from poor people to people of color to people with disabilities and immigrants. It also represses the people involved in social movements that struggle for a more equal society in order to prevent those movements from achieving popular power. Both parties denounced the social movement’s demand to decrease investment in the bureaucracies of repression and increase investment in systems of care.

They used three main tactics. First, they whipped up a frenzy over retail theft and street crimes, harms mainly associated in the public imagination with poor and marginalized people. A lot of this was not founded in facts. For instance, the supposed epidemic of shoplifting turned out to be a lie. It wasn’t going up nationally at all.

They used that fiction to deflect attention from the crimes perpetrated by police, prison guards, bankers, pharmaceutical executives, tax evaders, polluters, and health insurance companies. These cause far more death, injury, and harm to our safety than crimes committed by poor people. For example, FBI figures for all property crimes combined in the United States are dwarfed by estimates of corporate wage theft.

Second, as discussed at length in Copaganda, they claimed that crimes committed by marginalized people are increasing across the country. This fearmongering tricked lots of people into thinking that crime is going up. It’s actually plummeted to historic lows.

Third, liberal and conservative pundits and media claimed that the only solution to their manufactured lie of increasing crime is more investment in the punishment bureaucracy. So, dozens of cities expanded budgets for police and prisons each year since the killing of George Floyd.

Trump in particular has dramatically increased funding of the surveillance state. And he’s deploying its institutions like the National Guard, Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), and Customs and Border Protection (CBP) to collaborate with the police in city after city to crush marginalized people and political opposition.

How do these two parties carry out the same project in different ways?

author: Unknown
title: Temmuz zammının ardından hastaneden izlenimler
content:
Aylardır tüm memurlar gibi biz sağlık emekçilerinin de beklediği temmuz ayı zammı belirlendi. Ancak sonuç hepimiz için büyük bir hayal kırıklığı oldu. Çalışanlar arasında yüzde 13.5’lik zammın adeta bizimle dalga geçmek olduğu konuşuluyor. Zamla maaşlarımızda 9-13 bin lira arasında bir artış oldu. Oysa gıdadan elektriğe, sudan temizlik malzemelerine, giysiden daha birçok temel ihtiyaca kadar her şeye kat kat zam geldi.

Biz sağlık emekçileri 12 ay boyunca zor çalışma koşullarında, eksik personelle çalışıyoruz. Çoğu zaman dört kişinin yapması gereken işi bir sağlık emekçisi yapmak zorunda kalıyor. Kış aylarından indirimli ve taksitli olarak ayarladığımız tatillere bile artık gidemiyoruz. “Bırakın tatili, aç karnımızı bile zor doyuruyoruz” diyen arkadaşlarımız var. Bu şartlarda birçok sağlık emekçisi ek iş yapmak zorunda kalıyor. Kimi küçük bahçesinde yetiştirdiği, belki kendisine bile ancak yetecek sebzeleri satıyor. Kimi el emeğiyle yaptığı ürünleri satarak gelir elde etmeye çalışıyor. Kimi e-ticaret işleri yapıyor. Mesai sonrasında kafede çalışan da var, araba yıkayan da… Bu liste uzayıp gidiyor. Çünkü herkes gibi sağlık emekçisi de artık zar zor geçiniyor.

Çocuklarımız söz konusu olduğunda da durum farklı değil. Üç aylık okul tatilini ekonomik açıdan bir fırsat olarak görmek zorunda kalanlarımız var. Çocuğunu memleketine, anneannesinin ya da babaannesinin yanına gönderen, “Hiç değilse üç ay kurs ücreti vermiyoruz” diyenlerimiz var. Oysa kim ister üç ay boyunca çocuğundan ayrı kalmayı? Bir de okullar kapalıyken kendisi çalışmaya devam ettiği için çocuğuna bakacak kimseyi bulamayan ve mecburen kurslara astronomik ücretler ödeyen sağlık emekçileri var.

Tatil anlayışımız da ekonomik koşullara göre değişti. Bazı sağlık çalışanları daha ekonomik olsun diye ortak bir yazlık tutup iki-üç aile birlikte tatil yapıyor. Bazılarımız ise memlekette ailesinin yanına gidiyor hem birkaç gün orada kalıyor hem de kışlık hazırlıklarını yapıp dönüyor. Tatilini bu şekilde değerlendiren sağlık emekçilerinin sayısı da az değil.

Hastanede çalışırken çevreme baktığımda artık bunların tek tek insanların yaşadığı istisnai durumlar olmadığını görüyorum. Aynı koridorlarda çalışan, aynı nöbetleri tutan, aynı yoğunluğu yaşayan sağlık emekçilerinin ortak gündemi geçinebilmek. Aylarca beklediğimiz zamdan sonra bile konuştuğumuz şey dinlenmek ya da tatil yapmak değil; hangi masraftan kısacağımız, çocukların yaz aylarını nasıl geçireceği ve mesai sonrasında hangi ek işi yapabileceğimiz. Oysa biz, en temel ihtiyaçlarımızı bile tam olarak karşılayamadığımız bu koşulları değil; insanca yaşayabileceğimiz bir ücreti, dinlenebileceğimiz bir tatili, çocuklarımızla kaygı duymadan zaman geçirebilmeyi, mesai sonrasında başka bir işte çalışmak zorunda kalmadan hayatımızı sürdürebilmeyi istiyoruz.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Jaharra Anglin Stubbs
title: Massachusetts Expands Later Term Abortion Access
content:
Early Monday morning on August 10, 2026, Massachusetts Governor Maura Healey signed the Prioritizing Patient Access to Care Act into law, expanding access to abortion later in pregnancy and removing the state’s previous 24-week gestational limit. Under the new law, healthcare providers can determine whether abortion care is medically appropriate based on their professional judgment.

Previously, Massachusetts law generally limited abortion access to the first 24 weeks of pregnancy, creating a significant barrier for those seeking later-stage care. After that point, physicians could provide abortion care only under limited circumstances, including when necessary to preserve a patient’s life or physical or mental health, in cases of a lethal fetal diagnosis, or when the fetus was unlikely to survive outside the uterus.

Even within these exceptions, patients were sometimes denied care. State Representative Christine Barber shared that hospitals were still denying patients access to abortions, even when a fetus was determined unlikely to survive outside the uterus. As a result, Massachusetts patients were forced to leave the state, sometimes as far as the Southwest, to access the care they needed.

The new law changes that. As ACLU of Massachusetts Executive Director Carl Rose affirmed, Massachusetts residents facing dire medical complications can now receive essential healthcare without these rigid in-state limitations.

Massachusetts is now the 10th state, including Washington, D.C., to no longer have gestational limits on abortion access. That change could also make Massachusetts a “destination” for patients from states where abortion remains heavily restricted, particularly for those seeking care later in pregnancy.

Unfortunately, 13 states still enforce strict abortion bans at any stage of pregnancy, even though they claim there are exceptions to these rules. Across the country, vague or restrictive abortion laws have created uncertainty about when providers can legally provide care, leaving patients to bear the consequences.

Massachusetts’ new law represents an important recognition that abortion is health care and that decisions about pregnancy should be made by patients in consultation with their healthcare providers, not dictated by arbitrary legal restrictions.

​​But state-level protections alone cannot guarantee equitable access to abortion.

Although Massachusetts has taken a much-appreciated step to assert what we know to be true, that abortion is healthcare, there is still more work to be done. It is not enough to have examples of abortion protections at the state level; it is critical to have abortion protections across every border within the United States.

title: Antifa-Ost-Prozess: trotz Unterbringung in der Psychiatrie verhandlungsfähig?
content:
Ein weiterer zäher Prozesstag im Dresdner Antifa-Ost-Komplex fand diesen Mittwoch statt. Es ist schon fast 10:30 Uhr, als die wenigen Zuschauer:innen die sich eingefunden hatten, in den Saal dürfen, denn seit gestern war die Öffentlichkeit ausgeschlossen.


Was war passiert?


Einer der Angeklagten befindet sich in einer psychisch sehr belasteten Phase und verliert Lebenskraft sowie Lebensmut. Das zuständige Amtsgericht hat ihn zu seinem Schutz vorläufig in die Psychiatrie eingewiesen, dort darf er nichts besitzen, womit er sich das Leben nehmen könnte, keinen Gürtel, keinee Schnürsenkel, keine Ladekabel.


Dies war vermutlich schon am Tag zuvor in nicht-öffentlicher Sitzung erörtert, die Öffentlichkeit jedoch zum Schutz der persönlichen Belange des Betroffenen ausgeschlossen worden. Jetzt ist es aber sein Anwalt der in der heutigen Sitzung genau diese Details vorträgt, als er ein Obergutachten fordert.


Der eine Arzt der Klinik spricht davon, dass der Betroffene, wenn überhaupt, nur dann reisefähig ist, wenn medizinisches Personal diesen begleitet, ein anderer Arzt wiederum sieht keinerlei Bedenken was Verhandlungs- und Reisefähigkeit angeht.


Auch die Verhandlungsfähigkeit ist strittig, zum einen wegen der akuten Belastungsreaktion und krisenhaften Zuspitzung im Leben des Angeklagten, zum anderen wegen dessen Medikation, denn das verordnete Psychopharmakon wirkt stark dämpfend.


Das Oberlandesgericht lässt den Angeklagten jedoch aus der Psychiatrie nach Dresden bringen, ohne allerdings, dass das polizeiliche Begleitpersonal über die konkrete Situation umfassend informiert ist, ohne dass Notfallmedikamente zur Hand sind, ohne, dass die Polizei weiß was bei welchem Notfall konkret zu tun wäre. Der Anwalt ist ersichtlich empört, auch weil im Gerichtsgebäude sich dieses Unwissen bei den Wachtmeister:innen nahtlos fortsetzt.


Der Antrag wird entgegen genommen, aber eine Antwort einstweilen vom Vorsitzenden zurück gestellt.


Die einzige Zeugin des Tages


Geladen ist Kriminalhauptkommissarin Golze, die knapp eine viertel Stunde über ihre Vernehmung des angeblich geschädigten Neonazi Karl Jonas Kaden befragt wird. Dieser soll in Wurzen 2020 nach seiner Rückreise von einer Demonstration in Dresden, am Bahnhof in Wurzen attackiert worden sein.


Kaden selbst wollte am 19. März 2026 vor dem Oberlandesgericht

nicht aussagen

, er selbst befindet sich gerade in Haft, da er im „Sächsische-Separatisten-Prozess“ als Angeklagter vor Gericht steht.


Und so hangelt sich die Polizistin durch ihre Erinnerungen daran, was der Zeuge Kaden im Rahmen ihrer Vernehmung gesagt haben soll. Sie hätte ihn, nach Rücksprache mit seinen Eltern in dessen Kinderzimmer vernommen, er habe klar auf alle Fragen geantwortet und sich der AfD zugerechnet und als „geschichtsinteressiert“ bezeichnet. Mit ein paar anderen sei er nach Dresden Gefahren, wo jedes Jahr Nazis aufmarschieren um an die Bombardierung Dresdens zu erinnern.


Er sei von 15-20 Vermummten attackiert worden, eine Kopfwunde musste getackert werden. Da ihn jemand einen „Scheiß Nazi“ genannt habe, vermute er „Linke“ hinter dem Angriff. Wenig später wir die Zeugin im allgemeinen Einverständnis entlassen und darf gehen.


Langes Betrachten von Bildern auf dem Monitor


Der Rest des Prozesstages, der erneut von diversen Pausen geprägt war, vergeht damit, dass sich die Prozessbeteiligten und die zu Anfang noch 11, dann sieben und am Ende sechs Zuschauer:innen Fotos ansehen. Um den Prozess zu beschleunigen werden zahlreiche Akten im „Selbstleseverfahren“ eingebracht, sprich alle Beteiligten bekommen Zeit und Gelegenheit Aktenteile selbst zu lesen. Die Bilder jedoch, die müssen „in Augenschein“ genommen werden, in der Verhandlung.


So geht es dann mal in die Wohnung von Lina E. aus dem ersten Antifa-Ost-Prozess, man sieht einen Beutel an einer Türklinke hängen. Oder es werden Observationsphotos gezeigt, wobei hier eine der Verteidigerinnen der Verwertung widerspricht, da die rechtlichen Voraussetzungen für die Observation nicht vorgelegen hätten. Aufgabe der Ermittlungsrichter:innen sei es, Anträge auf Observation eigenständig, und unter Zuhilfenahme der Akten zu prüfen und nicht bloß abzunicken. Dazu Fotos von Handys oder deren Displays, wann wer wen angerufen hat.


Zustimmendes Gemurmel im Publikum kommt auf, als auf einem der präsentierten Bilder „Free Lina“ zu sehen ist.

author: Luis Barrueto
title: Vita Activa & the Digital Security Helpline join forces to support mental health and digital safety for activists
content:
A digital attack is never just a technical incident. It often comes with psychological distress, leads to burnout, and opens up new threats to physical safety that require expert support. At the same time, individuals coping with harassment or online violence often need more than mental health support; they need immediate technical assistance to secure their digital presence and stay safe.


Activists, nonprofit organizations, human rights defenders, independent journalists, and other at-risk communities may lack sufficient access to the resources and expertise they need to address these intertwined problems. By joining forces, Access Now’s

Digital Security Helpline

 and the nonprofit organization

Vita Activa

 aim to meet that need, ensuring that civil society members receive holistic, rapid, and tailored support. 


Vita Activa, an

Access Now grantee

, operates a helpline for journalists, activists, human rights defenders, women, and LGBTQ+ people who face stress, trauma, burnout, digital violence, or crises arising from their work and activism. Our Digital Security Helpline offers 24/7, free-of-charge technical assistance on digital security for members of civil society, with a specific

mandate

 to assist activists, researchers, media organizations, journalists, bloggers, and human rights defenders. 


Our new framework for collaboration will allow the two organizations to offer:


Holistic case referrals:

 With explicit consent from individuals seeking help, our organizations will streamline referrals to provide complementary support. A tech query at Vita Activa will seamlessly connect with the technical expertise of the Digital Security Helpline, while individuals contacting Access Now who need mental health assistance, peer support, or psychological first aid will be connected directly to Vita Activa.


Mutual collaboration to sustain the ecosystem of support for civil society:

 Our organizations already collaborate, offering one another mutual support through information sharing, documentation, joint efforts to develop sustainable solutions for our respective communities, and more. Our new framework formalizes this work and allows both teams to explore further avenues for collaboration.


How to reach out for support


If you or your organization are facing digital attacks, we encourage you to learn more about our respective services and reach out to either of our organizations depending on the type of support you need:


Experiencing online violence or burnout? Need psychological first aid?

If you meet the criteria for support,

contact

Vita Activa

 for free and confidential assistance in  in Spanish, Portuguese, English, and Arabic, at support @ vita-activa.org (Spanish) and support @ vita-activa.org (English)  or +56 9 3291 9018  (WhatsApp, Signal).


Facing a digital attack or incident that threatens your digital security? Need advice to prevent attacks or secure your online presence?

If your request fits within our

mandate

,

contact the Digital Security Helpline

, which provides direct technical assistance and support in nine languages.


As civil society continues to face mounting challenges to basic rights and freedoms worldwide, it is crucial to ensure that those most at risk have continuous holistic support and protection, especially given the drastic fund reductions that have

further exposed civil society to security vulnerabilities

. We are proud to work with Vita Activia on creative, collaborative, and flexible approaches to defending those who defend our rights.


The post

Vita Activa & the Digital Security Helpline join forces to support mental health and digital safety for activists

 appeared first on

Access Now

.

title: Victorian allied health workers strike for better pay, conditions
content:
Victorian allied health workers strike for better pay, conditions


Isaac Nellist


Wed, 12/08/2026 - 14:26


Jacob Andrewartha

,

Naarm/Melbourne


August 12, 2026

,


Issue 1460

,


News


Thousands of allied health professionals working in Victoria’s public hospitals took part in a 24-hour strike on August 11 demanding better pay and working conditions.


Striking healthcare workers gathered outside the Peter MacCallum Cancer Centre in Parkville where they heard from delegates and union officials.


Workers at the protest told Green Left that one of the main reasons for the strike was because allied health workers “need better working conditions and a genuine pay offer that keeps up with inflation”.


See also


Allied health workers call for fair pay, action on gender-based undervaluation


Victorian education workers continue to demand better pay, conditions


Historic council workers’ strike demands fair pay, conditions


Julia, a delegate at Bendigo Health, spoke about the challenges of working in rural healthcare where it’s hard to retain staff and asserted that “everyone deserves to have access to high quality care”.


She pointed out that the Victorian State government refusal to value healthcare professionals will have disproportionate impacts on healthcare in rural areas.


Andrew Hewat , executive officer for Victorian Allied Health Professionals Associations (VAHPA) said “the state government has boxed us into a corner” and that “healthcare workers are being disrespected by the state government not giving a genuine offer”.


VAHPA is campaigning for a 38.16% pay increase over three years. While Victorian Labor’s latest offer is reportedly only about 19-21% over four years.

title: Jeffries Says He Opposes Medicare for All — Which Would Save 114k Lives Yearly
content:
This is a reversal of his prior stance on the legislation, which he once cosponsored.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries (D-New York) has said that he now opposes Medicare for All, flipping on his previous stance just as Democrats are on the cusp of potentially winning back control of the House.

Medicare for All is “not legislation that I am currently cosponsoring or that I support,” Jeffries said in an interview on NBC’s “Meet the Press” on Sunday. Jeffries declined to say whether or not he would bring the legislation to a vote, though suggested that he wouldn’t, in the case that Democrats retake the House — which some pollsters say is a likely outcome.

This is a reversal of his stance from just a few years ago. Jeffries first announced that he was backing the legislation in 2019, and was listed as a cosponsor as recently as 2021. But he dropped off of the cosponsor list in 2023, after he succeeded Rep. Nancy Pelosi (California) to take the helm of House Democratic leader.

In the interview, Jeffries did not offer a different policy solution, but rather the vague promise that Democrats are “going to fight to make health care affordable for every single American,” he said.

Jeffries has often offered platitudes in the face of the health care crisis; last year, as Republicans were gutting the Affordable Care Act and kicking millions of Americans off of their health insurance, Jeffries simply said that, to push back, Democrats must “decisively address the Republican health care crisis because it is serious,” and that they must do so in a “bipartisan” way.

His latest statements came just days after Yale University and University of Maryland researchers released preprinted research finding that the universal single-payer health care system proposed under Medicare for All would prevent a whopping 114,000 deaths a year. At the same time, it would also save the U.S. over $1 trillion in health care costs annually, the study found — undercutting one of the biggest criticisms of the proposal.

Jeffries did not say why he has backed off his support for the legislation. But the tack to the right comes as he faces a new ascendant class of left-wing politicians taking over the Democratic Party, who are running on policy positions like abolishing Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), opposing the construction of data centers, and backing Medicare for All.

Unlike Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer (D-New York), Jeffries does not currently appear to be in danger of losing his position as head House Democrat. Still, he made several comments hostile to the left and left-wing priorities that could isolate incoming members of his own party.

In the interview, Jeffries said that he doesn’t support the Democratic Socialists of America’s policy agenda, and declined to say whether he believes that democratic socialists belong in the Democratic Party. He also declined to say if he would bring legislation on abolishing ICE to a vote if Democrats retake the House.

He instead said that he is “committed to dramatically reforming ICE” with proposals like unmasking ICE agents and ensuring they wear body cameras — though some places have already barred ICE agents from wearing masks, and the agency is already mandating the wearing of body cameras.

Jeffries has a history of hostility toward the left, and has continued to emphasize his opposition to more left-wing candidates for office. In June, after a slate of Zohran Mamdani-backed democratic socialist candidates swept House primary races in New York, Jeffries said that Mamdani has “work to do” in order to placate the more conservative wings of the Democratic Party.

author: Jake Johnson
title: Billionaire Google Co-Founder Spends $102M to Fund Opposition to CA Wealth Tax
content:
Sergey Brin is funding groups opposed to a one-time 5 percent tax that would fund Medicaid and public schools.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

Google co-founder Sergey Brin, one of the richest men in the world, has spent more than $100 million backing a group seeking to stop a popular California ballot initiative that would impose a one-time tax on the wealth of the state’s billionaires.

New filings reported by The Los Angeles Times detail Brin’s role in funding Building a Better California, which is pushing two ballot measures that would undercut and potentially nullify the proposed billionaire wealth tax. Building a Better California is also spending directly against the proposed tax, pumping at least $5 million into “no” efforts.

If passed, revenue from the 5% billionaire wealth tax would be used to offset federal Medicaid cuts and bolster the state’s education system. The proposal will be on California’s November ballot as Proposition 40, and the two billionaire-backed initiatives are Propositions 41 and 42.

Debru Carthan, the vice president of Service Employees International Union-United Healthcare Workers West, said in a statement that “California billionaire Sergey Brin would rather spend $100 million to fund a shady opposition campaign than simply pay his fair share in taxes so millions of Californians don’t lose their healthcare.”

“That’s shameful,” Carthan added. “Billionaires already pay much lower tax rates than what working families pay out of every paycheck.”

The Sergey Brin group Building a Better California is officially opposing the California billionaires tax — donating $5 million to the “No” push to defeat it. pic.twitter.com/GsP2h9ZhXR

Proposition 40 has been endorsed by the California Federation of Labor Unions, the California Nurses Association, and the California Democratic Party, as well as prominent progressive lawmakers such as Sen. Bernie Sanders (I-Vt.) and Rep. Ro Khanna (D-Calif.).

But the measure has drawn opposition from powerful forces in California, including Gov. Gavin Newsom, the California Chamber of Commerce, and the California Teachers Association.

Brin is not the only billionaire financing efforts to defeat the proposed wealth tax in California, which is home to more billionaires than any other U.S. state. Ripple Labs co-founder Chris Larsen, PayPal co-founder Peter Thiel, and venture capitalist Ron Conway have also spent against the ballot initiative.

Economists Emmanuel Saez and Gabriel Zucman have estimated that, between 2019 and 2025, California’s billionaires paid on average just 0.26% of their wealth each year in state income taxes.

“For the very richest individuals, the effective burden was even lower. The four wealthiest Californians — Mr. Brin, Mr. Huang, Mr. Page and Mr. Zuckerberg — paid an average of just 0.07% of their wealth annually in California income tax over that period,” Saez and Zucman wrote. “This trailblazing wealth tax would be a small (for the ultrawealthy) but important (for everyone else) step toward raising needed tax revenue and curbing the state’s runaway inequality.”

title: J. Aripas - Anarkisternas sång
content:
Författare

: J. Aripas

Titel

: Anarkisternas sång

Källa

: Tidningen Brand #47 1929


 Melodi: *"Tre trallande jäntor."


 Giv plats, ty nu komma vi unga

 som kämpa för framtidens land;

 hör frihetens sång som vi sjunga,

 se facklan vi tänt i vår hand...

 Mot våld och tyranni

 vi kämpa världen fri,

 vi sanningsfacklan svinga över allt kanaljeri.

 Kung kapital och stat

 vi ge vårt ädla hat

 men tro ej att de stäckas genom riksdagsmännens prat!


 Kom med i vår stridande skara,

 kom med under röda banér!

 Solidariteten vårt vapen skall vara

 som segern en gång åt oss ger...

 För frihet och för fred

 kom med, ja kommen med,

 att krigets onda härskarmakt föralltid krossa ned!

 På törnig stig ibland

 vi tåga hand i hand

 att grunda anarkismens fria, stolta morgonland!

title: Una Mirada Hacia El Futuro
content:
Título

: Una Mirada Hacia El Futuro

Fecha

: 1969

Notas

: Título original:

Looking Forward

. Traducido entre 2024-2026 por

La Conquista del Panda

 bajo licencia

CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

Fuente

: Obra original recuperada desde

archive.org


Dedicado a las personas jóvenes de todo el mundo que deben afrontar los retos del siglo XXI.


Sobre la obra


 Mirando al futuro es un libro imaginativo y fascinante en el que los autores te llevarán de viaje por la cultura y la tecnología del siglo XXI. Tras una sección introductoria en la que se analiza «lo que moldea nuestro futuro», explorarás los porqués del poco familiar, a veces alarmante, pero apasionante mundo de dentro de cien años.


 Verás esta sociedad a través de los ojos de Scott y Hella, una pareja del próximo siglo. Su vivienda está equipada con un cibernador, un dispositivo informático aparentemente mágico, pero basado en principios científicos hoy conocidos. Ayuda a regular las horas de sueño, las comunicaciones en todo el mundo, un increíble complejo de vida submarina e incluso la ingesta calórica diaria de la «joven» pareja. Son cuarentones, pero pueden esperar vivir 200 años. El mundo en el que viven Scott y Hella es un mundo que ha logrado el control total del clima, que ha desarrollado un ordenador del tamaño de un dedo que se implanta en el cerebro de cada bebé al nacer (y los bebés se incuban científicamente para que las mujeres del siglo XXI no tengan que pasar por los dolores del parto), y que ha perfeccionado la manipulación genética que permite mejorar la especie humana por medio de la ciencia.


 Económicamente, el mundo es utópico para nuestros estándares. Hace tiempo que desaparecieron los empleos, los salarios y el dinero. Nada tiene precio y las posesiones personales no son necesarias. Se ha superado el nacionalismo y se ha logrado el desarme total; la tecnología educativa ha dejado obsoletas las escuelas y los profesores. Los niños aprenden haciendo, y son independientes en este mundo amistoso a los cinco años.


 La principal fuente de esta sociedad mayor es el Centro de Correlación, «Cencor», un gigantesco complejo de ordenadores que sirve a la humanidad, pero nunca la esclaviza. Cencor regula la producción, la comunicación, el transporte y todas las demás tareas onerosas y monótonas del pasado. Esto libera a los seres humanos para que vivan experiencias creativas y estimulantes en lugar de vidas vacías de ocio sin sentido.


 Obviamente, este libro es especulativo, pero está sólidamente basado en los avances científicos que ahora se conocen. Y como dicen los autores:


Entenderás mejor este libro si eres de las que ven el hoy como un peldaño entre el ayer y el mañana.


Necesitarás ser sensible a las injusticias, a las oportunidades de felicidad perdidas y a los agudos conflictos que caracterizan a nuestra civilización del siglo XX. Si tu mente es capaz de sopesar nuevas ideas y evaluarlas con perspicacia, este libro es para ti.


No tenemos una bola de cristal. ...Queremos que introduzcas nuestras ideas en tu propio ordenador, para que puedas encontrar ideas aún mejores que puedan contribuir a moldear el futuro de nuestra civilización.


Sobre los autores


 Jacque Fresco trabajó como diseñador industrial durante treinta años, diseñando todo tipo de equipos, desde casas prefabricadas hasta automóviles, equipos electrónicos y médicos, sistemas de ingeniería ergonómica y cientos de productos comerciales e inventos. Ha diseñado y patentado artículos tan diversos como una estructura de ala de avión revolucionaria, patentada por la USAAF, y películas tridimensionales que no requieren el «uso de gafas especiales». Se han publicado numerosos artículos y fotografías sobre su trabajo en muchas revistas y periódicos. Ha ejercido de asesor técnico en varias películas, incluida una de las primeras sobre estaciones espaciales y un viaje a la Luna titulada «Project Moon Base». Vive en Miami.


 Kenneth S. Keyes, Jr., es un hombre polifacético. Estudió en la Universidad de Duke y se licenció en la Universidad de Miami, con la especialidad principal en psicología y la secundaria en música. Entre sus aficiones se encuentran el arte, la música sinfónica, la navegación a vela —vive a bordo de un yate de 71 pies llamado Caprice— y la escritura; es autor de

Cómo desarrollar tu capacidad de razonamiento

 y

Cómo vivir más tiempo, con más fuerza y más delgado

. Ha impartido clases en la División de Cursos Nocturnos de la Universidad de Miami …

title: Internationale situationniste - Nos buts et nos méthodes dans le scandale de Strasbourg
content:
Auteur·e

: Internationale situationniste

Titre

: Nos buts et nos méthodes dans le scandale de Strasbourg

Date

: 1967

Notes

: Revue

Internationale situationniste

 n°11, octobre 1967


 Les diverses manifestations de stupeur et d’indignation qui ont fait écho à la brochure situationniste

De la misère en milieu étudiant

, publiée aux frais de la section strasbourgeoise de l’Union Nationale des Étudiants de France, si elles ont eu l’effet opportun de faire lire assez largement les thèses contenues dans la brochure même, ne pouvaient manquer d’accumuler les contresens dans l’exposé et le commentaire de ce qui a été l’activité de l’I.S. en la circonstance. En face des illusions de tous genres entretenues par des journaux, des autorités universitaires, et même un certain nombre d’étudiants irréfléchis, nous allons maintenant préciser ici quelles ont été exactement les conditions de notre intervention, et rappeler quels buts nous poursuivions par les moyens qui nous ont paru y correspondre.


 Plus erronée même que les exagérations de la presse, ou de certains avocats adverses, sur l’ampleur des sommes que l’I.S. aurait saisi l’occasion de piller dans les caisses du malheureux syndicat d’étudiants, se trouve être cette information aberrante, dont les récits journalistiques ont fréquemment fait état, selon laquelle l’I.S. aurait pu s’abaisser à faire campagne devant les étudiants de Strasbourg, pour les persuader de la validité de ses perspectives, et pour faire élire un bureau sur un tel programme. Pas davantage, nous n’avons entrepris le moindre noyautage de l’U.N.E.F., en y glissant secrètement des partisans. Il suffit de nous lire pour comprendre que tels ne peuvent être nos champs d’intérêt, ni nos méthodes. En fait, quelques étudiants de Strasbourg vinrent nous trouver, pendant l’été de 1966, et nous firent savoir que six de leurs amis – et non eux-mêmes – venaient d’être élus comme direction de l’Association étudiante locale (A.F.G.E.S.), sans programme d’aucune sorte, et en dépit du fait qu’ils étaient notoirement connus dans l’U.N.E.F. comme des extrémistes en désaccord complet avec toutes les variantes de sa décomposition, et même résolus à tout casser. Leur élection, au reste tout à fait régulière, manifestait donc à l’évidence et le désintérêt absolu de la base, et l’aveu d’impuissance définitive de ce qui restait de bureaucrates dans cette organisation. Ceux-ci calculaient sans doute que le bureau « extrémiste » ne saurait pas trouver une quelconque expression de ses intentions négatives. C’était inversement la crainte des étudiants qui vinrent alors nous trouver ; et c’est principalement pour ce motif qu’eux-mêmes n’avaient pas cru devoir personnellement figurer dans cette « direction » : car seul un coup d’une certaine ampleur, et non quelque justification humoristique, pouvait sauver ses membres de l’air de compromission que comporte immédiatement un si pauvre rôle. Pour achever la complexité du problème, alors que les étudiants qui nous parlaient connaissaient les positions de l’I.S., et déclaraient les approuver en général, ceux qui étaient membres du bureau les ignoraient plutôt, mais comptaient principalement sur nos interlocuteurs pour définir au mieux l’activité qui pourrait correspondre à leur bonne volonté subversive.


 À ce stade, nous nous sommes bornés à conseiller la rédaction et la publication, par eux tous, d’un texte de critique générale du mouvement étudiant et de la société, un tel travail comportant au moins pour eux l’utilité de leur faire clarifier en commun ce qui leur restait confus. Nous soulignâmes en outre que le fait de disposer d’argent et de crédit était le point essentiel utilisable de la dérisoire autorité qui leur avait été si imprudemment laissée ; et qu’un emploi non-conformiste de ces ressources aurait à coup sûr l’avantage de choquer beaucoup de monde, et par là de faire mieux voir ce qu’ils pourraient mettre de non-conformiste dans le contenu. Ces camarades approuvèrent nos avis. Dans le développement de ce projet, ils restèrent en contact avec l’I.S., particulièrement par l’intermédiaire de Mustapha Khayati.


 La discussion et les premières ébauches de rédaction entreprises collectivement par ceux qui nous avaient rencontrés et les membres du bureau de l’A.F.G.E.S. – tous résolus à mener à bonne fin cette affaire – apportèrent au plan une importante modification. Tous se montraient d’accord sur le fond de la critique à produire, et précisément sur les grandes …

title: Генри Дэвид Торо - О гражданском неповиновении
content:
Автор

: Генри Дэвид Торо

Название

: О гражданском неповиновении

Дата

: 1849

Дополнительная информация

: Перевод: 3. Е. Александрова

Оригинальное название: "Civil Disobedience"

Источник

: https://biblioteka-online.org/book/o-grazdanskom-nepovinovenii/reader


 Я всецело согласен с утверждением: «лучшее правительство — то, которое правит как можно меньше», — и хотел бы, чтобы оно осуществлялось быстрее и более систематически. Осуществленное, оно сводится в конце концов — и за это я тоже стою — к девизу: Лучшее правительство то, которое не правит вовсе, а когда люди будут к этому готовы, то именно такие правительства у них и будут. Правительство является в лучшем случае всего лишь средством, но большинство правительств обычно—а иногда и все они—являются средствами недейственными. Возражения, приводившиеся против постоянной армии, — а они многочисленны и вески и должны бы восторжествовать — могут быть выдвинуты также и против постоянного правительства. Постоянная армия — это всего лишь рука постоянного правительства. Само правительство, являющееся только формой, в которой народу угодно осуществлять свою волю, тоже ведь может быть обращено во зло, прежде чем народ совершит через него то, что хочет. Доказательством служит нынешняя война в Мексике, затеянная небольшой группой людей, которые использовали постоянное правительство в качестве своего орудия, ибо народ с самого начала не согласился бы на такую меру.


А что такое американское правительство, как не традиция, хотя и недавняя, пытающаяся себя увековечить, но ежеминутно теряющая что-то от своей чистоты? Оно не обладает жизненной силой даже одного человека, ибо один человек может подчинить его своей воле. Для народа это нечто вроде деревянного ружья. Но от этого оно не менее необходимо; ибо народу нужен тот или иной сложный механизм, и притом шумный, чтобы чувствовать, что у него действительно есть правительство. Правительства, таким образом, доказывают, как легко удается для их же пользы обманывать людей и как они обманывают себя сами. Отличная вещь, мы все должны это признать; однако наше правительство еще ни разу само не способствовало никакому делу иначе, как быстро устраняясь с дороги. Не оно охраняет свободу страны. Не оно заселяет Запад. Не оно распространяет просвещение. Все это достигнуто благодаря чертам, присущим американскому народу, и достижений было бы больше, если бы правительство иной раз не мешало этому. Ибо правительство — это средство, с помощью которого люди хотели бы не мешать друг другу, и, как уже было сказано, это средство всегда наиболее действенно, когда меньше всего мешает своим подданным. Если бы торговля не была по своей природе резиновой, она никогда не смогла бы перепрыгивать все препятствия, какие воздвигают на ее пути законодатели; и если бы судить их только по результатам их действий, не учитывая их намерений, их следовало бы карать как тех злоумышленников, которые кладут посторонние предметы на рельсы.


Если говорить конкретно и как гражданин, а не как те, кто отрицает всякое правительство, я требую не немедленной отмены правительства, но его немедленного улучшения. Пусть каждый объявит, какое правительство он готов уважать, и это уже будет шагом к такому правительству.


Когда народ, получив в свои руки власть, передает ее большинству и долгое время позволяет ему править, это происходит не потому, что оно правит наиболее справедливо, и не потому, что это представляется всего справедливее по отношению к меньшинству, но по той простой причине, что оно физически сильнее. Но правительство, где правит большинство, не может быть основано на справедливости даже в том ограниченном смысле, в каком ее понимают люди. Неужели невозможно такое правительство, где о правде и неправде судило бы не большинство, а совесть? Где большинство решало бы лишь те вопросы, к которым приложима мерка целесообразности? Неужели гражданин должен, хотя бы на миг или в малейшей степени, передавать свою совесть в руки законодателя? К чему тогда каждому человеку совесть? Я считаю, что мы должны быть сперва людьми, а потом уж подданными правительства. Желательно воспитывать уважение не столько к закону, сколько к справедливости. Единственная обязанность, какую я имею право на себя брать, — это обязанность всегда поступать так, как мне кажется правильным. Справедливо говорят, что у корпорации нет совести; но корпорация, состоящая из совестливых людей, имеет совесть.
