title: Rojava’s Promise and the Dissolution of the SDF: Time for the Left to Rethink the Kurdish Question?
content:
Rezgar Akrawi: From this it follows that criticising the SDF is not criticism of the rights of the Kurdish people. Criticising the ruling parties in the Kurdistan Region is not criticism of the Kurdish cause. Rejecting the nation-state is not a rejection of national identity and national rights. It is a leftist position, one that calls for national solidarity to be freed from subordination to elites and authorities, for the question of national liberation to be tied to the struggle for democracy, equality and social justice, and for the united struggle of working women and men by hand and by brain across every nationality and community.

The Kurdish question as a case in point: a call for a citizenship state and social justice with a socialist horizon.

On 25 August 2026, Mazloum Abdi announced from the People's Palace in Damascus that the mission of the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) had ended and that it was dissolving as an independent military force. The Autonomous Administration went with it, along with every military and civilian formation attached to it, all of them absorbed into the institutions of the Syrian state. The announcement followed the broad military operation launched by government forces in January 2026. That operation cost the SDF large stretches of the territory it controlled, and it opened a negotiating track that ended in an agreement to integrate its forces and institutions into the Syrian state.

I regard this as a positive development. It reduces the likelihood of devastating nationalist wars, and the first victims of such wars are always workers and the labouring poor of every nationality. The successive agreements, from March 2025 to the comprehensive agreement of January 2026 and on to the announcement of dissolution, did lower the risk of war and spared the region further destruction. Yet they contained no provision whatsoever on the questions we fight for as leftist and progressive forces: women's rights, the secular character of the state, an end to privatisation, protection of the public sector, guarantees for the rights of working women and men by hand and by brain, the achievement of social justice, and democratic elections for every official.

For years, a wide segment of the Kurdish and international left presented this model as a leftist social, feminist and grassroots democratic revolution. It ended by a decision taken at the top and announced from a presidential palace in Damascus. There was no popular referendum, and no declared decision by the councils and communes that the SDF had presented to the world as the true holders of sovereignty in what was called the "Autonomous Administration," supposedly built on the power of the people. The United States had been the principal military and political backer of the SDF, while at the same time supporting the political and military trajectory of the new authorities in Damascus. It was therefore a central party in shaping the course of the war, and then the course of its resolution. That fact alone reveals where decision-making power actually sat the entire time, and how far a wager on the major imperialist powers can be trusted.

What stands out is how the costs were distributed. The new state absorbed a section of the military and party elite of the SDF, notwithstanding that state's class, religious and authoritarian character. A number of SDF commanders were appointed to military posts and others received ranks and administrative positions. They became an active part of the military, political, administrative and security apparatus of the Syrian government, and of its capitalist class structure. Working women and men by hand and by brain, meanwhile, Kurds, Arabs, Syriacs and every other community, were left facing the same social, economic and political problems that preceded the war, now sharpened by years of conflict and destruction.

In parallel, decrees were issued recognising the Kurds as a constituent part of the Syrian people, recognising Kurdish as a national language and Newroz as a national holiday, and lifting the effects of the unjust 1962 Hasakah census. These are real gains, and generations struggled for them. Yet the recognition came once the balance of power had already been settled, not before. Rights granted by decree can be withdrawn by a counter-decree, all the more so under an undemocratic government resting on Islamist organisations with a history of repression and violence. title: Patrick Mérin - Théisme, nationalisme, capitalisme… les religions vont bien
content:
Auteur·e

: Patrick Mérin

Titre

: Théisme, nationalisme, capitalisme… les religions vont bien

Date

: 2017

Source

: Extrait le 23 août 2026 de

https://le-cafe-anarchiste.info/theisme-nationalisme-capitalisme-les-religions-vont-bien/


 Faut-il crier avec les loups contre la religion théiste islamique actuellement médiatisé ? Non. Le mouvement libertaire révolutionnaire (ne parlons pas de certains signataires du confusionniste « appel des libertaires contre l'islamophobie ») est clair concernant les religions (théistes, nationalistes, capitalistes) depuis bien longtemps. ni contre l'une ni contre l'autre des religions en particulier, mais contre toutes les religions qui de fait enrégimentent les consciences/vivants dans des idées/relations totalitaires, guerrières et qui laissent perdurer, pour la cause, la soumission/domination et l'exploitation des humains par d'autres. L'objet de la critique est ici les religions révélées (islamique notamment mais les autres aussi) mais aussi les religions capitalistes et nationalistes (O/NU/TAN) qui imposent selon leur croyance un monde de soumission. L'objectif est aussi de répondre à nombres de propos ou réflexions de compagnons de travail (musulmans et autres) avec qui j'ai pu éprouver l'actualité et la non profondeur de certaines réflexions, tendant à réduire un individu à une communauté, à une religion de naissance ou à une couleur de peau.


 Que des personnes croient en une entité « supérieure » (Dieu/Nation/Capital) pourrait ne pas être spécialement problématique, tant qu'il n'y aurait pas de volonté prosélytique, expansionniste ni des conséquences néfastes sur les vivants. Le problème est que ces croyants s'identifient à un livre sacré/une frontière/un code de loi, qui veut imposer la croyance à tous et qui interdit d'exprimer/expérimenter ses refus/critiques sur les pratiques/écrits dits sacrés/intangibles. Quand on croit au bien d'une telle Entité, on ne devrait pas à avoir à l'imposer, et pourtant ils l'imposent de gré ou de force... La plupart des croyants considèrent qu'ils doivent suivre la croyance/tradition familiale. Hors si ce qui les intéresse est leur entité, ils ne devraient pas avoir besoin d'un livre, d'une frontière, d'un code de loi pour expliquer/vivre cette entité. Seule leur conviction intime, leur ressenti, devrait suffire, hors on peut remarquer que les religions théistes (thora, bible, coran…), nationalistes (français, allemand, marocain, algérien, …), capitalistes (propriétaire, locataire, salarié, marché, main invisible, …) sont généralement prosélytes et enrégimentent les consciences dans des « communautés » imaginaires pour mieux manipuler le sentiment « collectif ». D'ailleurs, un croyant même si il n'est pas extrémiste, de fait, permet aux extrémistes de poser leur logiques en s'appuyant sur la masse des croyants. Un compagnon croyant n'est pas apriori mon ennemi, l'ennemi est le militant théiste/nationaliste/capitaliste/hiérarchiste qui a une démarche proactive afin d'imposer son dogme. Néanmoins, un compagnon croyant se repose sur une entité que l'on peut manipuler sur la forme ou le fond et pour laquelle tout est bon, un peu de rhétorique et l'affaire est dans le sac, ça peut aller d'un sens ou d'un autre, quand certains disent paix, d'autres disent guerre, car dans les écrits dites sacrés des entités on trouve ce qu'on veut bien y trouver… Le seul moyen efficace de dégager ces militants religieux est de ne plus croire à leur religion (de croire à ce qu'on croit sans intermédiaire), et non essayer d'adoucir leurs croyances par des réformes ou des bons sentiments, sinon ils s'appuient sur les croyants de leur religion pour asseoir leur pouvoir, leur folie.


 En effet, les religions, sont des milieux d'hypocrisie, de haine et de guerre larvée ou directe, qui ne peuvent s'empêcher de mentir / abrutir / menacer / exclure / opprimer / massacrer afin d'instaurer LEUR PAIX. La paix des Dieux, la paix des Nations, la paix des Capitaux, ils en ont jamais assez, alors lorsque leur PAIX est menacé, ils font la guerre. Les différentes religions monothéistes se font la guerre entre elles, les différentes religions nationalistes se font la guerre entre elles, les différentes religions capitalistes se font la guerre entre elles, et il y a évidemment la guerre entre les différentes variétés de religions nationalo-théisto-capitalistes… Combien de millions de morts du fait de ces entités ? Trop, malheureusement. Évidemment, comme rien ne doit être …

author: Unknown
title: Мария Замир - Слон экоцида: Что убивает природу?
content:
Автор

: Мария Замир

Название

: Слон экоцида: Что убивает природу?

Дата

: 17.06.2026


Слон экоцида: Что убивает Природу?


 Глобальный экоцид – повсеместное уничтожение Природы – это катастрофа, от которой больше нигде нельзя скрыться. Естественная среда под атакой везде: в городах и пригородах, в деревнях и в самых диких лесах, на горных вершинах, в океанах и заповедниках. Этот процесс не останавливается ни на минуту. Мира, каким он был до начала войны с ним цивилизации, больше не существует, а то, что чудом сохранилось в виде оазисов, сейчас безжалостно истребляется. При этом большинство людей не имеют никакого понятия о том, что живут в погибающем мире и что дикой природы почти не осталось, не знают они ничего и о роли биосферы в поддержании жизни. И у них нет никакого желания что-то знать и тем более переживать о судьбе родной планеты. Есть небольшая группа тех, кого волнует гибель Природы, но обычно они видят лишь отдельные проблемы, с которыми и надлежит бороться, такие как строительство на заповедных территориях, загрязнение среды отходами, экологическое невежество населения или беззаконие властей и бизнеса. А само явление глобального экоцида, суть этого смертоносного процесса, охватившего всю Землю, а не частные его проявления, ими не рассматривается.


 Люди, замечающие вокруг себя уничтожение Природы, но не видящие общей картины происходящего – катастрофы планетарного экоцида, – напоминают слепых из древнеиндийской притчи. Пытаясь ответить на вопрос «что такое слон?», каждый из них ощупывает лишь одну часть тела животного, но никто не понимает, что оно представляет собой как целое. Так каков же он как целое – «слон» экоцида? Или, говоря иначе, что происходит со всей планетой, с какой болезнью она столкнулась и в чём её глубинные причины? В чём суть происходящего? Что является двигателем экоцида, если свести все отдельные проблемы к единой основе? Почему уничтожают лес, почему с невиданной скоростью вымирают виды, почему всё завалено пластиком и нет чистых рек, почему даже заповедники находятся под угрозой?


 Здесь уместно вспомнить ещё одного неузнанного слона, на сей раз из английской идиомы «elephant in the room» (дословно «слон в комнате») – о какой-то явной проблеме, которую невозможно не замечать, но о которой присутствующие не говорят, потому что это неприятно или не принято в обществе. Это выражение отлично описывает тот факт, что слона могут не видеть в упор не только слепые, но и вполне зрячие, по крайней мере, физически, и такая умственная слепота возможна для всего социума в целом, что мы и наблюдаем в нашем мире сегодня. Природа исчезает везде, на глазах у всех, но люди этого

не видят

, потому что причина её исчезновения хоть и очевидна, но слишком некомфортна для осознания, а потому о ней не говорят (и не думают).


 Так что это за слон такой в нашей планетарной «комнате»? Что это за деятельность, которая уничтожает Природу каждый день, в любой части мира, и которую упорно «не замечают», предпочитая говорить о зелёных технологиях, устойчивом развитии или экологичном образе жизни? Она настолько привычна, что стала невидимой, как воздух, который везде и о котором никто не думает – им просто дышат и всё. И в то же время она составляет самую суть цивилизации, является первоосновой её существования и главным отличием от природоцентричных культур.


 Деятельность эта –

природозамещение

: замещение Природы цивилизацией и её искусственной оболочкой – техносферой (сферой рукотворных объектов и трансформированных территорий). Эта среда пригодна только для существования в ней человека и глубоко антагонистична по отношению к биосфере, паразитирует на ней и её разрушает.


Замещение Природы собой

 – это то, для чего и чем живет цивилизация, что отражено в повестках, планах и целях всех без исключения стран и обозначается эвфемизмом «хозяйственное освоение территорий», то, чем она определяется и гордится. Любое государство, как и вся цивилизация в целом, – это сверхмощная машина переработки естественных экосистем в техносферу, в мир убитой и переделанной Природы.


 В логике цивилизации на Земле существуют две глобальные системы, потенциально способные управлять жизнью: Природа – то, что было изначально и возникло само по себе, и она сама – структура, созданная человеком. Природа в мифе цивилизации – это сила неразумная, неуправляемая, опасная, бесцельная, совершенно непригодная для жизни человечества в своем нетрансформированном виде и вдобавок к этому – некомфортная, неудобная, не ставящая …

author: Franck Dick Rosete
title: UN body fortifies demand to free detained journalist, activists
content:
“To ignore this UN ruling is to further slain the Philippines’ record on press freedom, human rights, and democracy.”


CAGAYAN DE ORO — A United Nations (UN) working group considered the immediate release of a detained journalist and human rights workers as the appropriate remedy after it concluded that their detention is arbitrary.


The UN Working Group on Arbitrary Detention’s Opinion No. 22/2026, which was adopted in its 105th session from March 23 to April 1, 2026, concluded that the deprivation of liberty of journalist Frenchie Mae Cumpio, church worker Marielle Domequil, and human rights worker Alexander Abinguna contravened the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, making it arbitrary. The opinion has been made public recently.


The UN body requested the Philippine government to take the necessary remedy, adding that it should also launch a full and independent investigation of the circumstances surrounding the arbitrary deprivation of liberty of the accused.


The three are part of the five individuals arrested in simultaneous raids in Tacloban City—collectively known as the

Tacloban 5

. The two others, People Surge Network spokesperson Marissa Cabaljao and Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) Eastern Visayas staff Mira Legion, were out on bail.


Cumpio and Domequil, presently detained at the Correctional Institution for Women, were convicted of terrorism financing in January. Abinguna, on the other hand, is facing alleged illegal possession of firearms and explosives and murder charges. He is currently detained at the Tacloban City Jail.


TIMELINE:


The prolonged detention of Filipino journalist Frenchie Mae Cumpio


On October 27, 2025, the UN working group transmitted the allegations against Cumpio, Domequil, and Abinguna to the Philippine government, requesting the state to provide detailed information about the factual and legal grounds of the accused’s detention by December 2025. 


However, the body did not receive a response from the Philippine government, prompting the group to render its opinion—which was recently released—based on the claims submitted by its source.


The UN working group concluded that the arbitrary deprivation of liberty of the three accused is arbitrary under four categories. It stated that their continuing detention has no legal basis considering the absence of the proper presentation of search warrants and the acquittal of Cumpio and Domequil from their charges relating to illegal possession of firearms and explosives, as well as the dismissal of murder charges against the journalist.


It also concluded that the three were prosecuted because of their work as a journalist and human rights defenders, including raising concerns on alleged police and military abuses and the plight of farmers. It also stated that their deprivation of liberty gave an arbitrary character due to their prolonged and continuing pretrial since their arrest in February 2020. 


Lastly, the UN body concluded that Cumpio, Domequil, and Abinguna were deprived of liberty on discriminatory grounds due to their political opinions and status as human rights defenders.


“The Working Group requests the Government to translate, publish, and disseminate the present opinion through all available means and as widely as possible,” a part of the opinion reads.


Human rights alliance Karapatan welcomed the UN body’s opinion, stressing that the courts handling the case of the three accused should be informed regarding the matter. For the group, these conclusions reaffirmed their position that the charges filed against the Tacloban 5 were trumped up.


“The inordinate delay of the court proceedings that has prolonged their detention is an additional layer of injustice against the three. Their release should immediately be given due course,” said Cristina Palabay. Karapatan secretary-general.


For Altermidya coordinator Avon Ang, the UN working group’s opinion shows the Philippine government’s failure to recognize that the imprisonment of Cumpio, Domequil, and Abinguna is about silencing dissent.


“The Marcos administration and our courts can no longer pretend this is a normal criminal case. The government must immediately release them and end the use of anti?terror laws to target journalists, church workers, and activists,” Ang said in a statement sent to

Bulatlat

. “To ignore this UN ruling is to further slain the Philippines’ record on press …

title: Mass graves must be opened
content:
As discussions continue over ending the conflict in Turkey and launching a new peace process, the fate of thousands of people who have been missing for years is once again coming to the fore. Although the Kurdish Freedom Movement has released the names of some guerrillas who lost their lives in clashes, the whereabouts and burial places of many of their remains are still unknown.


Since the 1990s in particular, families of the missing have struggled to recover the remains of their relatives and have them identified. The Saturday Mothers/People have also continued their longstanding protests, demanding that the fate of the missing be disclosed and that families be able to recover their loved ones.


According to data from the Human Rights Association (IHD), the remains of 4,201 people are believed to be buried in 348 identified mass graves across Turkey, some of which have been excavated while others remain unopened. Families and human rights organisations are calling for mass graves to be excavated in accordance with scientific standards, for identification procedures to be accelerated, and for the remains of those who disappeared during the years of conflict to be returned to their families.


According to IHD reports, the provinces with the highest concentration of mass graves include Diyarbakır (Amed), Siirt (Sêrt), Bitlis (Bedlîs), Şırnak (Şirnex), Van (Wan), Hakkari (Colemêrg) and Bingöl (Çewlîg). These areas have been among those most severely affected by the conflict since the 1990s.


The issue is not confined to the past. The Kurdish Freedom Movement has recently released the names of a number of guerrillas who lost their lives in clashes. However, families are reportedly still unaware of where many of those named were buried. Some have spent years trying to learn what happened to their relatives without ever being able to recover their remains.


Cemeteries in the mountains


The remains of many people who lost their lives in clashes are believed to be buried in areas stretching across Besta, Gabar, Herekol, Garzan, Cudi and Mava-Faraşin, particularly in the region encompassing Siirt, Batman (Êlih), Bitlis, Şırnak and Hakkari.


Some of these burial sites were established by relatives of those who lost their lives and by civilians living in the region. Figures of symbolic importance to the Kurdish movement, including Azime, Mehmet Goyi and Kendal, are also reported to be buried in these cemeteries.


The fate of thousands of people in Turkey remains unknown as a result of the intense conflict and unsolved killings of the 1990s. For years, the Saturday Mothers/People have continued their struggle for the missing to be found, the circumstances of their disappearance to be investigated and their fate to be disclosed.


Historical background of violations against the dead


Violations against the bodies of the dead have a long history in Turkey. From 1915 to Dersim, from Zilan to Newala Qesaba, and from the 1990s to the present day, practices such as withholding remains from families, keeping bodies in morgues for prolonged periods, obstructing burials, burying people without identification and destroying cemeteries have been documented at different times.


The IHD and families of the missing are calling for sites believed to contain mass graves to be protected and for evidence to be safeguarded against destruction through construction, roadworks or other forms of intervention.


For families, the fundamental demands are the definitive identification of missing persons, the return of their remains and recognition of their right to mourn.


The excavation of graves is not regarded as an ordinary digging operation, but as a process that must be carried out in accordance with forensic and archaeological standards. Families and human rights organisations are calling for evidence to be preserved, remains to be recovered using appropriate methods and identification procedures to be conducted according to scientific standards in line with the United Nations’ Minnesota Protocol.


Experts warn that uncontrolled excavations using heavy machinery such as excavators and bulldozers can damage biological and forensic evidence. For this reason, forensic specialists, anthropologists, archaeologists and other relevant experts should be involved in the excavation of mass graves.


The large number of unidentified remains has also highlighted the need to systematically collect DNA samples from families and establish a …

title: CDK-S and YJK-S call for participation in 2nd Kurdish Culture and Arts Festival
content:
Final preparations are underway for the 2nd Kurdish Culture and Arts Festival, which will take place tomorrow, Saturday 29 August in Zurich, Switzerland.


The Festival Organizing Committee met at the Zurich Democratic Kurdish Community Center (Dem-Kurd) to review the final preparations. During the meeting, freedom guerrillas whose deaths were announced in recent days were also commemorated.


Following the meeting, the Democratic Kurdish Council of Switzerland (CDK-S) and the Kurdish Women’s Union of Switzerland (YJK-S) issued a joint statement calling for participation in the festival.


 


Speaking on behalf of the Festival Organizing Committee, artist Kawa Urmiye emphasized the significance of this year’s festival and said: “Although the announcement of these martyrdoms has caused deep sorrow among our people both in the homeland and in the diaspora, we will act in accordance with the wishes of our martyrs. We will uphold our values in line with their message: ‘Do not mourn endlessly for us or wear black because of us. If you are followers of our struggle, you must carry the banner of freedom even further.’


We call on our people to participate in the festival on August 29. By attending with all our colors and diversity, we must respond to the heroes of our homeland. We invite all our people to join us on Saturday at Zurich’s Hardturm Areal to commemorate all heroes, represented by Comrade Egîd, the immortal commander of the August 15 Initiative.”


Tribute to the martyrs of Kurdistan


The joint statement of CDK-S and YJK-S was read by CDK-S Co-Chair Dilan Çetinkaya. Paying tribute to the guerrillas whose deaths are currently being published, the statement said: “In this historic period we are living through, we experience both the joy and sorrow of moving toward peace with hope. For years, the brave sons and daughters of the Kurdish people waged an uncompromising struggle to reach this stage. For the free future of their people, they never let the torch of freedom fall from their hands. In recent times, the freedom movement has announced the martyrdom of many comrades who gave their lives without hesitation for freedom.


We remember these martyrs of freedom with respect and gratitude. We extend our condolences to their families and to the people of Kurdistan. We bow respectfully before their memory and once again renew our commitment and promise to keep their memory alive in our struggle.”


 


We will uphold the legacy of the martyrs


The statement emphasized that the festival would be held in the spirit of August 15 and called on people to uphold the legacy of the martyrs. The statement added: “On this basis, it is the responsibility of all of us to protect the legacy and values of our martyred comrades and to take our place in this historic process. Everyone must participate on the basis of Leader Apo’s philosophy and the paradigm of women’s freedom. Everyone must clearly fulfill their role.”


Festival dedicated to the martyrs


The CDK-S and YJK-S said that this year’s festival is dedicated to the martyrs and added: “For this reason, we are determined to hold our festival in the spirit of August 15. This year, we dedicate our traditional August 15 Initiative Festival to our martyrs whose martyrdoms were recently announced. We salute them with the spirit of the August 15 resistance. We aim to organize our festival in a manner worthy of the memory of our martyrs.


Dear people, we once again emphasize the importance of the festival we will hold during this historic period. Let us come together and rekindle the torch of freedom under the guidance of our martyrs at this festival. Let us share our grief together and organize our lives under the slogan ‘Free Leadership, Free Tomorrows.’


On this basis, as YJK-S and CDK-S, we call on our people living in Switzerland to support the festival, strengthen the struggle for freedom and peace, and contribute to the construction of a democratic future. We invite all our institutions and organizations to uphold the common values of our people and the legacy our martyrs have left us, and to join together in advancing the struggle to realize their dreams.”


The program of the festival


The 2nd Kurdish Culture and Arts Festival in Switzerland will be held this year at Hardturm Areal in Zurich under the slogan: “Building a democratic society with the spirit of the August 15 resistance.”


The festival will feature performances by Koma Agirê Jiyan, Tara Memedova …

title: PAJK and KJK call on Kurds and their friends to keep the dreams of the martyrs alive
content:
The coordination bodies of the Party of Free Women of Kurdistan (PAJK) and the Kurdistan Women’s Community (KJK) commemorated those whose deaths were recently announced and extended their condolences to their families and the Kurdish people. In a joint statement, PAJK and KJK also commemorated members of the Kurdish freedom movement who lost their lives in August.


The women’s organizations stated that carrying forward the goals of the martyrs means participating in the building of a democratic society and intensifying the struggle for the physical freedom of Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan.


The statement, titled “To All Our Esteemed Families, Our Patriotic People and the Democratic Public,” reads as follows:


“The greatest value of the Kurdish people is the martyrs who fought for a free country and a dignified life and gave their lives for this cause. Throughout the course of our struggle, we have lost hundreds of esteemed comrades every month. On the occasion of August, we commemorate all those who fell during this month with love, respect and gratitude, in the persons of our comrades Jiyan (Yıldız Durmuş), Ekin Van, Deniz Fırat, Erdal, Kasım Engin, Atakan Mahir and Mustafa Yöndem.


They stood against injustice and the undignified life imposed upon the Kurdish people and turned toward the mountains of Kurdistan. We know that the true architects of all the gains we have achieved today are our self-sacrificing martyrs. As women and as a people, we have reached where we are today on the foundation of their legacy, and we will build our future upon it as well. We know that every endeavor founded upon the legacy of our incomparable martyrs will lead us to success.


Rêber Apo [Abdullah Öcalan] said, “Do not bury the martyrs in the earth, but in your hearts.” In doing so, he expressed how we should live with our martyrs. For every person who has found a place in our hearts is both a reason for us to struggle and a light that illuminates our path.


They fought for a free life and to forge a free Kurdish identity, leaving us a profound legacy. Through their lives, their struggle and their efforts to build a free life, they answered for us the question, “How should we live?” They were those who devoted themselves to a free life. Expecting nothing in return, they lived as some of the humblest and most beautiful people in this world, always giving of themselves.


They became the successors of Hayri Durmuş, who asked that the words, “He departed still indebted to his people,” be inscribed on his gravestone, and of Zîlan, who said, “If only we had something other than our lives that we could give.”


Dear patriotic people,


As you know, one of the decisions of the PKK’s 12th Congress was to announce the deaths of those whose deaths could not previously be made public due to the severe conditions of war. In this context, the deaths of numerous comrades are currently being announced in Amed, Istanbul, Van, Gever and Cizîra Botan, while commemorations are also being held for those whose deaths have already been announced.


We extend our condolences, in particular, to the families of our martyrs and to our entire people. We renew our pledge to our martyrs to build a free country and a dignified life. Our people commemorate their sons and daughters with great dignity and determination and pledge to remain faithful to their memory. The mass participation in funeral ceremonies and commemorative events is a response to the call of Rêber Apo and our martyrs. In particular, the stance, conviction and commitment of the mothers at these commemorations call upon us to devote ourselves even more resolutely to the struggle and bring it to success.


The heaviest price of our struggle spanning more than half a century has undoubtedly been the deaths of these esteemed comrades. The announcement of their deaths has created a deeply emotional atmosphere among our people and among us, while at the same time further strengthening our determination to struggle.


Our first promises were made to them. We promised to fulfill their hopes, dreams and aspirations. We said that nothing they had begun would be left unfinished. For we know that none of our comrades said, “We are dying, and everything is over.” On the contrary, through this struggle they recognized the life worth embracing.


As unparalleled defenders and builders of the struggle and the path of a free life, they opened the doors to a meaningful and free life for us women. When …

author: Unknown
title: The pain and resistance hidden in the stones of Derase
content:
Some had been swept here by the wind like fallen leaves; others arrived clutching the last handfuls of hope left from a homeland consumed by flames. Undoubtedly, they were the children of the sun; they knew the secret of rising again from their own ashes. Though they had left behind immense tragedies, unrelenting pain, and rivers of tears, within the womb of hope they were always carrying the promise of a new dawn.


And so, they had not vanished. Those who reigned over the darkness had failed to erase these ancient names from the face of the earth. They were simply waiting—for that blessed day when the sun would rise never to set again; for the moment when Derwêş’s twelve cavalrymen would return, when they would reclaim the history buried in that land and crown it anew from the ashes of ruins and devastation.


Now we, too, stand on the threshold of this dawn, tracing the remnants of a hidden history on the rugged slopes of Shengal—a history left behind by different civilizations and buried beneath the soil of time.


In an age when the outside world ground humanity down through struggles for power, relentless massacres, and devastating famines, there were ancient valleys sheltered behind immense mountains. For centuries, this land became the one gateway to salvation for countless peoples who had lost their homelands, despite their different languages and beliefs. While these majestic mountains, with their rocky chests, bore the merciless storms raging beyond them, their fertile soil nurtured every wounded soul who sought refuge there with the same compassion.


Under the dark shadow of genocide and massacres, the Yazidi and Armenian peoples, bound by a shared fate, were no strangers to one another’s wounds. In 1915, when Armenians were subjected to the Ottoman Empire’s brutal policies of deportation and extermination, they found one of the safest places of refuge in Yazidi lands. It was an unshakable bond of trust forged through a shared memory of suffering.


When we sift through the ashes of the past, what emerges is an epic of resistance by two ancient peoples struggling to survive amid the rugged geography of the Middle East. In the aftermath of 1915, one group of Armenians made their way toward the mountains of Shengal.


Derase was one of the foremost sacred refuges where those seeking shelter on the rugged slopes of Shengal and in the homeland of the Yazidis made their home. Today, every step we take in Derase, every stone that catches our eye, is laden with the profound sorrow of that era. The atmosphere carries us beyond the boundaries of time, making us relive the past through the pain of the present. All that remained from those days were ruins and stone chambers—

shikefts

—where memories had taken refuge. Each shikeft bore the hidden seal of immense tragedy and an unyielding will to survive.


This river of suffering would flow once again along the same course in 2014, with one of the gravest genocidal campaigns of the 21st century. Faced with a dark campaign that sought to uproot Yazidism and erase it from the face of the earth, the Yazidi people, guided by their historical memory, once again sought refuge in Derase. At that terrifying moment, when the world turned its back and fled and darkness descended upon Shengal like a nightmare, freedom fighters carrying the banner of human dignity advanced against the darkness and changed the course of history.


It was no coincidence that the twelve cavalrymen who came to confront the latest Yazidi Genocide turned this place into a stronghold of resistance; this place carried the echoes of an ancient tradition. What was being targeted in the persons of the twelve cavalrymen who resisted there, were the Armenian roots whose memory was sought to be erased and the unyielding resistance of the Yazidis.


For the first time, through these twelve cavalrymen, history reversed a tragic fate woven with suffering. Derase was no longer merely a refuge for survival; it became a monument to resistance, crowned with the victory of Yazidi heroism and dignity.


As our footsteps echo across the stones of this ancient land, its haunting atmosphere envelops our souls. Every trace of the past seems to gaze back at the present through the mirror of history. And the valley’s timeless wind whispers the same lullaby to every weary soul who crosses its threshold:


“Rest. You are safe here; this is the shared home of wounded humanity.”

author: Unknown
title: Iranian forces arrest five Kurdish men in Ilam province
content:
Iranian forces have arrested Kurdish citizens Milad Alaei-Nasab, Amin Nasseri, Yasser Havasizadeh, Rouhollah Gholami and Younes Bekri without warrants in Darreh Shahr, Asemanabad and Sarableh, Ilam Province, over the past week.


The Kurdistan Human Rights Network (KHRN) has reported that on 23 August, officers of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Intelligence Organisation shot Nasseri in the leg and arrested him after he was wounded.


Nasseri, a Kurdish singer from Asemanabad, had been wanted by the security agencies following the December 2025–January 2026 protests.


Security forces arrested Gholami and Bekri, two other citizens from Asemanabad, at the same time.


On 24 August, security forces surrounded the Pir Hamzeh area of Asemanabad and violently arrested Havasizadeh.


Three days later, on 27 August, security forces arrested Alaei-Nasab, from Darreh Shahr, in the city.


Despite the families’ attempts to obtain information about the five, the security and judicial authorities have refused to respond or provide any explanation about their situation.


No information is available regarding the reasons for the arrests or the charges brought against them.

author: Unknown
title: PYD: Syria’s new constitution must recognize the Kurdish people, their rights and language
content:
The Democratic Union Party (PYD) issued a written statement regarding the latest developments in Syria. The party described some of the steps taken recently in Syria as positive and important, while stressing that these developments are not sufficient to provide a comprehensive solution to the Kurdish question.


The PYD particularly welcomed the steps toward integrating the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) into state institutions, as well as the developments concerning the Kurdish language, which will be permitted to be taught in public and private schools in areas where Kurds constitute a significant portion of the population.


The statement noted that these developments are important for the construction of a new Syria, saying: “These developments are positive and important steps, but they are not sufficient. The Kurdish question in Syria is a fundamental issue, and the rights of the Kurdish people must be an integral part of the constitutional and political framework of the new Syria.”


The statement stressed that Kurdish participation in building state institutions and in the country’s political, military, administrative and cultural life represents a source of strength for Syria, emphasizing that such participation would reinforce the country’s unity and stability.


The PYD also stated that the Women’s Protection Units (YPJ) should be integrated into the state’s official institutions.


The integration of the YPJ, it added, should be carried out in a manner that reflects the role and status of women in building the new Syria.


The PYD also outlined its demands regarding Syria’s new constitution, stating that the Kurdish people should receive constitutional recognition.


The statement said: “Syria’s new constitution must explicitly recognize the Kurdish people as a united and constituent people in Syria; it must recognize the Kurdish language and the political, cultural and national rights of the Kurdish people. In doing so, it must establish the principle of genuine partnership among all components of Syrian society.”


The PYD pointed out that the new Syria should be built on the principles of democracy, partnership and recognition of diversity, calling for the rights of all peoples and communities to be constitutionally guaranteed.


In conclusion, the statement stressed that the steps taken in Syria are welcomed but need to be complemented by new constitutional arrangements, describing this as “the path toward genuine partnership and a strong Syria enriched by its diversity and by all its peoples and communities.”

author: DebConf 25
title: Integrating Knowledge Graphs into the Debian Ecosystem
content:
by Alexander Belikov


At: DebConf25


https://debconf25.debconf.org/talks/99-integrating-knowledge-graphs-into-the-debian-ecosystem/


In an era where software systems are increasingly complex and interconnected, understanding and managing the relationships between packages, maintainers, dependencies, and vulnerabilities is paramount. This talk explores the innovative integration of knowledge graphs into the Debian ecosystem, offering a structured and semantic approach to package management and analysis.


We'll delve into how knowledge graphs can unify diverse data sources — such as package metadata, security advisories, and reproducibility reports — into an interconnected model that enhances visibility and reasoning capabilities. By representing entities (like packages and maintainers) and their relationships, we can facilitate advanced queries and insights that traditional systems may not easily provide.


Key Takeaways:


Semantic Integration: Learn how to map Debian's rich metadata into a coherent knowledge graph, enabling seamless integration and interoperability.

Enhanced Use Cases:

- Tracking and validating package dependencies.
- Identifying and analyzing vulnerability propagation.
- Assessing license compatibility and compliance.
- Auditing build reproducibility across packages.
- Highlighting Areas Lacking Reproducible Builds.
- Mapping Community Needs: Linking data from platforms like "grow-your-ideas" with package metadata to identify areas lacking attention
- Informing Funding Decisions: Providing data-driven insights to allocate resources effectively, ensuring that critical community needs are addressed.


Community Collaboration:


Understand how this approach can foster collaboration within the Debian community, providing tools for maintainers, developers, and researchers to contribute and benefit from shared insights.

author: DebConf 25
title: Using Debusine to pre-test your unstable uploads
content:
by Colin Watson


At: DebConf25


https://debconf25.debconf.org/talks/29-using-debusine-to-pre-test-your-unstable-uploads/


Debusine can build and run tests against your Debian uploads before sending them to the Debian archive. It can build your upload on multiple architectures and run the autopkgtests of your reverse dependencies against these builds. Only once everything has passed will your upload continue to Debian.


You can use this to pre-test your uploads to unstable, giving you confidence that your uploads will be able to migrate to testing. This is very useful during the freeze.


This talk is aimed at a broad audience of Debian contributors. We'll tell you what debusine is, if you haven't heard about it. For those who have, we’ll show you some of the features we’ve implemented in the last year, and how you can use them to do QA work in Debian right now. Including dput-ng integration, and scaling into clouds.


Debusine is a general-purpose software factory tailored to the needs of a Debian-based distribution. It manages the scheduling and distribution of tasks to distributed worker machines. It’s free software, implemented in Python, and packaged in the Debian archive.

title: tag2upload - upload simply by pushing a signed git tag
content:
by Ian Jackson


At: DebConf25


https://debconf25.debconf.org/talks/120-tag2upload-upload-simply-by-pushing-a-signed-git-tag/


Uploading to Debian is a complicated and balky business involving tarballs, patches, and arcane runes.


tag2upload allows DDs and DMs to upload by simply pushing a signed git tag, to salsa.  A robot then automatically, reliably, and traceably, builds the source package and uploads it to the Debian archive.


tag2upload is currently in a phased launch.  With luck there will be demo - but uploading with git-debpush is very quick and easy, so don't blink, or you'll miss it!


I'll also discuss some speculative future possibilities.

title: Federated instant messaging, 100% debianized
content:
by Elena Grandi


At: DebConf25


https://debconf25.debconf.org/talks/161-federated-instant-messaging-100-debianized/


Getting away from centralized services is now more important than ever; thanks to prosody or ejabberd and a number of clients for all tastes, it is easy to community-host your own federated XMPP server and chat away in a secure and federated way while only using software that is packaged for Debian. And if you are a Debian Developer, there is also already a community doing the hosting for you.


In this talk I'll give an overview of what XMPP is, why it is a suitable solution to the IM needs of today, and how it's better than some alternatives, and then provide a few pointers on what to do to join it, either by self/community hosting themselves or by joining an existing server, including a short update on Debian's own instance.

title: Debian Financials BoF
content:
by Paulo Santana


At: DebConf25


https://debconf25.debconf.org/talks/188-debian-financials-bof/


From Andreas email:


Debian incurs ongoing expenses to support its infrastructure--particularly hardware maintenance and upgrades--as well as to fund in-person meetings like sprints and mini-DebConfs. These investments are essential to our continued success: they enable productive collaboration and ensure the robustness of the operating system we provide to users and derivative distributions around the world.


While DebConf benefits from generous sponsorship, and we regularly receive donated hardware, there is still considerable room to grow our financial base--especially to support less visible but equally critical activities. One key goal is to establish a more constant and predictable stream of income, helping Debian plan ahead and respond more flexibly to emerging needs.


This presents an excellent opportunity for contributors who may not be involved in packaging or technical development. Many of us in Debian are engineers first--and fundraising is not something we've been trained to do. But just like technical work, building sustainable funding requires expertise and long-term engagement.


If you're someone who's passionate about Free Software and has experience with fundraising, donor outreach, sponsorship acquisition, or nonprofit development strategy, we would deeply value your help. Supporting Debian doesn't have to mean writing code. Helping us build a steady and reliable financial foundation is just as important--and could make a lasting impact.

author: Ash Sarkar
title: Meta: $18bn Poorer, Teenagers None the Wiser
content:
A coalition of 29 states, led by California, Colorado, Kentucky and New Jersey, has accused Meta of knowingly harming young people with its products – and Meta, rather than letting the federal trial proceed to its conclusion, has settled for $18bn (£15.4bn). 


To put that in terms Mark Zuckerberg can understand, that’s the equivalent of

60 megayachts

. Or, in terms I can understand, more than 4 billion Tesco meal deals

without

 a Clubcard.


So, what was the case? Though Meta insisted in court that child safety was a top priority for the company (no giggling from the gallery, please), the plaintiffs argued that the tech giant had designed its products, including Facebook and Instagram, to keep young people

compulsively engaged

. The states produced

internal documents

 in which Meta employees discussed “addiction”, problematic use and teenagers having difficulty managing their time; one internal product document discussed teenagers’ heightened sensitivity to dopamine and said this created product “opportunities”.


While the judge did not find conclusive proof that Meta had deliberately engineered their products to be addictive to teenagers, there was enough material that the claim could be put to the test. You can see how that’s a big

ruh roh

 from a corporate perspective.


What’s more, the court heard testimony which suggested that Meta were well aware that young people had real difficulty in disengaging from the apps, and that the company’s much-touted safety features were about as useful as a chocolate parasol. Arturo Béjar, an ex-Meta safety engineer, said that the company’s mental health and safety features were “

designed to fail

”. 


“It’s like [if] you have a car and they give you some brakes, but the brakes are in the trunk,” he told a federal court in Oakland. “You have to go look for it and install it before you turn it on.”


The states alleged that Meta told lawmakers, parents and the public very different things from what they understood in their own internal research. It was also argued that Meta allegedly knew, or deliberately avoided knowing, that children under the age of 13 were using its platforms, while continuing to collect their data without the safeguards required by federal law.


The pinnacle of the states’ case was that all of these things added up to Meta’s products interfering with, and significantly damaging, the ordinary experiences of adolescent life. Though it wasn’t argued that Meta’s social media platforms invented adolescent mental health problems, it was argued that they contributed to or aggravated problems including anxiety, depression, negative body image, disordered eating and, in severe cases, suicidal thinking. You can see why Mark Zuckerberg may have wished to avoid being pressed on the stand. 


There are some

big changes coming down the line

 for Meta’s American users. As part of the settlement, Meta will make safety restrictions the default setting for teens who set up an account. Young users will be limited to two hours on the app per day, though that can be changed by parents (or, let’s face it, enterprising teens). Visible ‘likes’ will be disabled by default, and filters which mimic cosmetic procedures will also be barred for young people. Luckily, society is otherwise really good at promoting realistic, procedure-free standards of beauty.


$18bn both is, and isn’t, a lot of money for Meta. The parent company of Instagram, WhatsApp and Facebook is worth more than a trillion dollars; it can afford $18bn, but the sum plus the raft of new safety measures is a sign that the era of social media impunity is waning. Maybe it’s too late – by now, tech giants have had unfettered access to three generations of digital natives (millennials, zoomers, and gen Alpha), and our brains are irrevocably cooked to the consistency of scrambled eggs. But perhaps the case itself points to a fragile green shoot of hope: the people yearn to be freed from the screen.

title: Case filed in Germany against Yüksel Koç on allegations of PKK membership
content:
Germany’s Federal Public Prosecutor’s Office has filed a case against former Co-Chair of the Congress of Democratic Kurdish Society in Europe (KCDK-E), Yüksel Koç, on charges of “membership in a foreign terrorist organization.”


In a statement issued on August 27, the Federal Public Prosecutor’s Office said that proceedings against Koç were initiated on August 6, 2026, before the State Security Senate of the Higher Regional Court of Hamburg.


The Federal Public Prosecutor’s Office stated that Koç is accused of “membership in a foreign terrorist organization” under Sections 129a and 129b of the German Criminal Code.


KCDK-E activities were cited as the basis for charges


The indictment states that Koç served as KCDK-E Co-Chair from June 2016 to July 2023.


The Federal Public Prosecutor’s Office alleges that during this period, Koç coordinated public advocacy activities in Europe, delivered speeches at various events, and worked with Kurdish organizations and media outlets.


These activities were cited in the indictment as the basis for the allegation of PKK membership.


Arrested in 2025


Yüksel Koç was detained and arrested on 20 May 2025. The arrest warrant against him was suspended on 1 August 2025, by an investigating judge at the Federal Court of Justice.


At the request of the Federal Public Prosecutor’s Office, the arrest warrant against Koç was fully revoked on 7 May 2026.

author: Unknown
title: 34th International Kurdish Culture Festival dedicated to martyrs
content:
The Congress of Democratic Societies of Kurdistan in Europe (KCDK-E) and the Kurdish Women’s Movement in Europe (TJK-E) said in a joint written statement: “At this historic moment, we are commemorating the Martyrs of Freedom wherever we live.”


The statement continued: "Above all, we once again commemorate the martyrs from Diyarbakır (Amed), Van (Wan), Hakkari (Colemêrg), Muş (Mûş), Botan and Mardin (Mêrdîn) whose deaths were recently announced, as well as all our martyrs who lost their lives in the struggle for freedom. We renew our pledge to build a democratic society in order to realise their goals and dreams. We remember with respect, love and gratitude all our martyrs who wrote their names in golden letters in the history of the Kurdish freedom struggle, who fought for freedom across all four parts of Kurdistan and sacrificed their lives for this cause.


We are determined to continue our struggle for the free future our martyrs dreamed of and for the freedom of Abdullah Öcalan."


The statement continued: "We call on all our people and institutions, particularly those living in the diaspora, to commemorate our martyrs wherever we are and to strengthen the struggle to rebuild life around the perspective of democratic society and peace, based on Öcalan’s philosophy and the paradigm of women’s freedom.


In this context, we call on our people and friends living in Europe to keep alive the great spirit of resistance embodied by our martyrs in the struggle for the freedom of Öcalan and the building of a democratic society.


Preserving our language, culture, history and social values against cultural genocide and passing them on to future generations is one of our most fundamental responsibilities."


The statement underlined that "throughout history, our culture and language have been the cornerstone of our people’s identity and social existence. Preserving and developing our culture, honouring our martyrs and bringing these together with the values of democratic society in the pursuit of a free life are therefore among our most fundamental responsibilities.


On this basis, we dedicate the 34th International Kurdish Culture Festival, which will be held under the slogan ‘Towards a Democratic Society with a Free Öcalan,’ to the martyrs of freedom.


As KCDK-E and TJK-E, we will hold the 34th International Kurdish Culture Festival in Dortmund, Germany, on 5 September this year.


We call on all the people of Kurdistan, particularly those living in Europe, as well as friends of our people and democratic institutions and organisations, to take part in the 34th International Kurdish Culture Festival, to keep our culture alive together, to honour the martyrs of freedom and to strengthen the struggle."

title: Karayılan: Due to wartime conditions, we were unable to announce the deaths at the time
content:
Murat Karayılan, a member of the People’s Defense Center (HSM) Command, answered ANF’s questions and spoke about the recently announced deaths of guerrilla fighters, the commemorations and condolence gatherings held in many cities across Kurdistan, the reasons for the delay in announcing the deaths, the status of the remains, and solidarity with the families of those who lost their lives. Karayılan drew attention to the commemorations held for 230 martyrs in Amed (Diyarbakır), Istanbul, Van, Gever, Cizre, Botan and Nusaybin, stating that the large turnout demonstrated Kurdish society’s commitment to those it regards as martyrs and to its values.


Karayılan said that, due to the intense warfare of recent years and security considerations, information about some deaths had reached the headquarters with delays, adding that there were also deaths that have not yet been publicly announced. He stated that there are 520 martyrs from Northern Kurdistan whose deaths are awaiting announcement, while a smaller number of unannounced martyrs are from other parts of Kurdistan. He added that they aim to make all of these cases public in the coming weeks and months.


Karayılan also shared comprehensive figures on the number of martyrs for the first time, stating that 25,922 deaths had been officially recorded between 1976 and 2026, and that the figure reaches approximately 27,000 when those who were not registered are included. Regarding the martyrs whose deaths were recently announced, Karayılan said that, with the exception of a few, the remains of the vast majority are under their control and that efforts are underway to bring them together in martyrs’ cemeteries.


Commenting on the new methods of struggle to be pursued as part of the Peace and Democratic Society Process, Karayılan said, “We are transitioning from the phase of armed struggle to a phase of political and social struggle.”


“We have abandoned the strategy of armed struggle, but we have not abandoned the struggle itself,” Karayılan said, adding that the new period would be one in which democratic politics and social organization would be expanded.


The first part of the in-depth interview with Murat Karayılan is as follows:


From its earliest days, one of the fundamental sources of strength for the Apoist movement has been its martyrs. Leader Apo (Abdullah Öcalan) clearly defined the place of martyrs in the struggle when he said, “The PKK is the party of martyrs.” As a movement, how do you assess the meaning and significance of the martyrs?


First of all, I extend my greetings and respects to all the staff of your agency and to all your viewers. Over the past week, commemorations have been held in Amed, Istanbul, Van, Gever, Cizre-Botan and Nusaybin for 230 heroic martyrs. I commemorate all our heroic martyrs with respect, reverence and gratitude. I bow respectfully before their memory and once again reaffirm the promise we made to them. We say to them: May your souls rest in peace; your flag will always fly high, and your cause will achieve success. We will remain committed to the path of comradeship until the very end, and we will turn your aspirations and dreams into reality.


On behalf of our headquarters and the entire leadership of our movement, I extend my condolences to the families of all our esteemed martyrs. We offer our condolences to all the families and to the entire Kurdish people. In particular, I salute the esteemed mothers who raised these courageous Kurdish sons and daughters, and I kiss their hands with respect. They raised and nurtured such courageous children with honor.


Leader Apo’s remark, “The PKK is the party of martyrs,” expresses a reality. This is because our movement was indeed founded by martyrs. It has marched with martyrs and grown through them. This statement reflects a historical truth: heroes—the courageous—have always held a significant place in the history of societies. Looking at history, we see that societies unable to produce courageous individuals or heroes from within their own ranks have struggled to preserve their existence. Societies that failed to create their own heroes have fragmented, assimilated and disappeared. Those that did create their own heroes, however, gained strength, developed social and national values, and were thereby able to preserve their existence.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: "Who Paid, Who Gained": Juan González on How Chicago Funded Real Estate Instead of Social Services
content:
A team of researchers led by

Democracy Now!

’s Juan González at the University of Illinois Chicago recently released an in-depth study on how, through a program called Tax Increment Financing (

TIF

), Chicago has spent some $16 billion in property taxes it collected over the past 40 years to fund downtown development. The money was supposed to be used to eliminate urban blight. ”

TIF

 funding has actually exacerbated economic inequities throughout the city, pouring more than half of the billions of dollars that it collected into downtown neighborhoods, while 70 other community areas around the city were left to share the other half,” says González.

title: "Don't Be Squeamish About Squamous, Get a Checkup!" Amy Goodman's Personal Health Update
content:
Amy Goodman is back to hosting

Democracy Now!

 after taking time off following a medical procedure to remove skin cells on her nose that tested positive for squamous cell cancer. “I think it’s important that … we don’t have to be picture-perfect on TV or video. We are not plastic; we are people. And people get by in all sorts of ways around the world,” says Goodman. She reminds listeners and viewers to check in with the dermatologist: “A spot, a bump on their skin, a mole or a blemish anywhere, or just a rough spot, something scaly, might be cancerous.”

title: 2015: Letzte Reform der Erbschaftsteuer bzw. der Steuer-Schlupflöcher für Superreiche
content:
Dossier


„

Das Bundeskabinett hat am 8.7.2015 den Gesetzentwurf zur Anpassung des Erbschaftsteuer- und Schenkungsteuergesetzes an die Rechtsprechung des Bundesverfassungsgerichts beschlossen. Die Reform bleibt jedoch umstritten

…“

Meldung vom 09.07.2015 samt Details, Gesetzentwurf und Übersicht bei Haufe Online


 und Kommentare:


Forderung eines Zusammenschlusses von 21 Verbänden: Erneut Milliarden-Steuergeschenke für Großerben – Erbschaftsteuer muss endlich gerecht werden


„34 Großerb*innen erhielten im Jahr 2025 Steuererlasse von insgesamt 3,7 Milliarden Euro. Das zeigen neue Zahlen des Statistischen Bundesamts zur Erbschaft- und Schenkungsteuer. Möglich macht das die 2016 eingeführte Verschonungsbedarfsprüfung für Unternehmensvermögen oberhalb von 26 Millionen Euro. Superreiche Unternehmenserb*innen zahlen in Deutschland damit faktisch kaum Erbschaftsteuer. Die Großerb*innen erhielten zusammen Vermögen von etwa 12 Milliarden Euro. Darauf mussten sie im Durchschnitt nur rund 2 Prozent Erbschaftsteuer zahlen, weil ihnen 94 Prozent der festgesetzten Steuer erlassen wurden. Stefan Körzell, stellvertretender DGB-Vorsitzender: “Die Bundesregierung muss endlich aufhören, beim Sozialstaat und den Beschäftigten zu sparen, und stattdessen große Erbschaften und milliardenschwere Vermögen stärker in die Pflicht nehmen. Dabei geht es nicht um das selbstgenutzte Familienheim, das Eltern ihren Kindern vererben. Es geht um große Unternehmensvermögen und Milliarden-Erbschaften – um Vermögen, das mit eigener Leistung der Erbinnen und Erben nichts zu tun hat. Rente, Gesundheitsversorgung und soziale Sicherung haben sich die Beschäftigten hart verdient. Deshalb braucht es endlich eine gerechte Erbschaftsteuer.” Die Vermögensungleichheit in Deutschland ist im internationalen Vergleich besonders hoch, und Erbvermögen spielen dabei eine zunehmend größere Rolle. Mittlerweile ist mehr als die Hälfte des privaten Vermögens geerbt und nicht mehr selbst erarbeitet. Rund drei Viertel der deutschen Milliardär*innen haben ihr Vermögen überwiegend geerbt. Damit leben in Deutschland so viele Erbmilliardär*innen wie in kaum einem anderen Land. (…) Die Privilegien für Unternehmenserb*innen sind die größte Steuersubvention im Bundeshaushalt. Seit ihrer Einführung 2009 sind der Allgemeinheit dadurch bereits über 100 Milliarden Euro entgangen. (…) Als Zusammenschluss von 21 Sozialverbänden, Gewerkschaften, Umweltorganisationen und zivilgesellschaftlichen Initiativen, die mehrere Millionen Menschen in Deutschland vertreten, fordern wir die Bundesregierung auf, Steuersubventionen für Erb*innen sehr großer Unternehmensvermögen zu streichen. Die Bundesregierung muss über eine gerechte Besteuerung sehr großer Vermögen eine angemessene Beteiligung von Superreichen an der Finanzierung des Gemeinwohls sicherstellen. Nur so lassen sich gesamtgesellschaftliche Belastungen fair verteilen sowie die ökologische Modernisierung und der gesellschaftliche Zusammenhalt stärken.“


DGB-Pressemitteilung vom 26. August 2026

 


[Petition] Ehrensache Erbschaftsteuer: Keine Ausnahmen für Milliardäre!


„

Milliardärsfamilien können ihr Vermögen in Deutschland fast steuerfrei vererben – während Menschen mit geringeren Erbschaften zahlen müssen. Statt einen angemessenen Beitrag zur Finanzierung gesellschaftlicher Aufgaben zu übernehmen, können Milliardäre ihren Reichtum in geschlossenen Familiendynastien fast unversteuert über Generationen weiterreichen. Seit Jahrzehnten sichern sich Milliardärsfamilien mit massiver Lobbyarbeit maßgeschneiderte Ausnahmen bei der Erbschaftsteuer – und das, obwohl höchste Gerichte diese wiederholt als verfassungswidrig beurteilt haben. Wir sagen: Diese Ausnahmen sind ungerecht. Sie untergraben den sozialen Zusammenhalt und gefährden unsere Demokratie

…“

Petition bei Finanzwende e.V.


 an die Bundesregierung aus CDU/CSU und SPD


[DGB] Darum ist es Zeit für eine gerechte Erbschaftsteuer. 


„Ausnahmen und juristische Schlupflöcher verhindern, dass Superreiche bei Erbschaften und Schenkungen angemessen besteuert werden. Die Steuerexpertin Julia Jirmann zeigt, welche gewaltigen Summen dem deutschen Staat durch Lappen gehen und wie eine gerechte Erbschaftsteuer aussehen kann.


Kaum eine Steuer wird so emotional diskutiert, wie jene auf Erbschaften und Schenkungen. Das steht im Gegensatz zu ihrem schlichten Grundgedanken: Erbschaften werden beim Vermögensaufbau in Deutschland immer bedeutender und tragen entscheidend zur sozialen …

title: Denizcilerin direnişi kazanımla sonuçlandı
content:
Samsun'da demirli Volgo Don 5021 adlı gemisinde 4 aydır ücretleri ödenmediği için eylemde olan denizcilerin mücadelesi kazanımla sonuçlandı.

İşçilerin Mayıs, Haziran, Temmuz ücretleri ödendi. Ağustos ayı ödemeleri için yazılı taahhüt verildi.

Deniz İşçileri Platformu günlerdir gemide hakları ve onurları için taviz vermeden mücadele eden denizcilerin direnişini zaferle tamamladığını bildirdi. Süreç boyunca deniz işçilerinin sesi olan platform, gazetecilere ve sendikalara teşekkür etti, "Bu zaferin asıl mimarı ve gerçek sahibi, gemide günlerce hakkına ve onuruna kararlılıkla sahip çıkan denizcilerimizdir. Örgütlü mücadele eden deniz işçisi mutlaka kazanır" dedi. Açıklamada platformun deniz işçilerinin mücadelesini her alanda duyurmaya devam edeceği ifade edildi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: anred
title: Los 13 años de Vaca Muerta y la farsa de bienestar colectivo
content:
Foto: Martín Álvarez Mullally


Esta semana se conmemora otro aniversario del pacto secreto entre YPF y Chevron que abrió las puertas a la explotación de Vaca Muerta. La meta extractiva avanza a paso firme, pero el prometido “derrame” de bienestar social nunca llegó. Un recorrido histórico por esta larga década de promesas incumplidas.

Por Marcelo García, para Observatorio Petrolero Sur (OPSur).


Vaca Muerta se convirtió en el epicentro productivo de la Argentina y en paralelo se transforma en una farsa de felicidad colectiva como alternativa de no futuro. Los niveles de producción de petróleo alcanzan ritmos históricos y cuando las petroleras puedan exportar el gas como GNL superarán ampliamente los records pudiendo transformar al país en un importante polo exportador. La pregunta de fondo y fundamental que se debe hacer el país es si deben explotar los recursos naturales no convencionales, en todo caso para qué y en beneficio de quién. Por ahora sólo resultan grandes ganadoras las petroleras que obtienen ganancias abultadísimas, los dólares del saldo exportable son para distribuir dividendos, los beneficios de la actual YPF no se traducen en ninguna mejora para el Estado nacional y sólo se acumulan dólares para pagar de la deuda externa. En la otra orilla el conjunto de la sociedad empobrecida y endeudada no entra en Vaca Muerta, pero tampoco se beneficia de un “derrame” inexistente. Además, el costo ambiental es brutal para las comunidades involucradas en el marco de un proceso de saqueo, privado y extranjero, de los recursos naturales.


Motor del saqueo subsidiado


Los ritmos de producción de Vaca Muerta baten récords históricos en el país y como aún la infraestructura es insuficiente y escuálida es de suponer que, si se superan esos obstáculos, se transformará en un segmento de mayor crecimiento aún a partir de la explotación de los recursos naturales no convencionales.


La historia productiva de Vaca Muerta comenzó allá en el año 2012 a partir de la decisión política del gobierno de Cristina Kirchner de impulsar y desarrollar la explotación de los hidrocarburos no convencionales.


Para lograrlo firmó un acuerdo secreto con la petrolera norteamericana Chevron con el objetivo de obtener el conocimiento necesario para implementar el fracking, mientras que en paralelo implementó un mecanismo de subsidios estatales para las compañías privadas.


Esos aportes del Estado fueron fundamentales para el desembarco y despegue de las petroleras privadas encabezadas por YPF que acababa de ser estatizada en un 51%. Con la gestión de Mauricio Macri los subsidios se dispararon a niveles récord y se mantuvieron a menor ritmo durante la gestión de Alberto Fernández e inclusive llegaron hasta el actual gobierno de Javier Milei.


Fuente: Elaboración propia en base a los datos de ASAP (Asociación Argentina de Presupuesto y Administración Financiera Pública).


Sólo por subsidios a las petroleras el Estado nacional destinó más de 12.000 millones de dólares con la finalidad de encender el motor de Vaca Muerta donde no hubo “grieta” y todos los gobiernos aportaron para el desarrollo con subvención estatal.


Los gráficos de la Secretaría de Energía muestran no solamente el aumento de la producción petrolera no convencional, sino también la declinación de la explotación de los yacimientos maduros convencionales. Un proceso que va mucho más allá de la merma natural de los reservorios y los ritmos de extracción, y se explica por los declinantes procesos de inversión.


Fuente: Secretaría de Energía de la Nación.


Sucedió que gracias a los subsidios estatales y altos precios del crudo internacional, las compañías comenzaron a migrar sus inversiones hacia Vaca Muerta y los planes de expansión se focalizaron en la Cuenca Neuquina. Cuando Vaca Muerta se echó a rodar las ganancias se multiplicaron exponencialmente y las operadoras se están quedando con la rentabilidad extraordinaria generada.


Ese aumento de la rentabilidad se consiguió a costa también de la reducción del costo laboral. Desde la época del sindicalista petrolero Guillermo “El Caballo” Pereyra y Mauricio Macri se firmaron convenios colectivos de trabajo que aumentaban la productividad y las condiciones de superexplotación de los trabajadores en Vaca Muerta, lo que causó –producto de las disminuidas medidas de seguridad– más de una decena de muertes en los yacimientos. author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: "Shut Down Dilley": Rep. Joaquin Castro on "Abusive" ICE Family Jail, Targeting of Military Families
content:
Calls to shut down the

ICE

 jail known as the Dilley Immigration Processing Center in South Texas continue to grow following the detention and deportation of 5-year-old Liam Tadeo and his father Victor Martinez Nieto to Mexico. According to the family’s lawyer, Nieto had begged officers to let his son go as they were arrested on their way to soccer practice in Austin last week. Nieto wanted Liam released to his mother, but

ICE

 reportedly refused. The arrest happened just days before Liam was set to start kindergarten.


Texas Democratic Congressmember Joaquin Castro previously attempted to visit Liam and his father at Dilley but was denied by

ICE

. Last month, Castro led a group of more than 110 Democratic House members in a nationwide call to end family detention and shut down Dilley. “You have kids as young as 2 months old who have been in prison there,” says Castro. “And every child that’s put in there — every woman, every person — there are American investors who are making money off of their imprisonment.”


Castro notes that children are not supposed to be held in detention centers for more than 20 days. “I’ve met with kids who have been there three months, seven months, 10 months. And so, this is really abusive, and it’s traumatizing a lot of kids.”

title: Brandbrief von Lehrkräften über Rechtsextremismus an der Schule: Oft verharmlost und kein Einzelfall, nicht nur in Brandenburg

Dossier


„

Nach einem

Brandbrief über rechtsextreme Vorfälle


 an einer Schule in Brandenburg hat der designierte Bildungsminister Steffen Freiberg (SPD) die Lehrkräfte zu Offenheit aufgerufen. (…) Die Forscherin Heike Radvan forderte, die Kultusministerkonferenz (KMK) solle sich stärker mit Rechtsextremismus an Schulen vor allem in Ostdeutschland befassen. Die Amadeu Antonio Stiftung hofft, dass der Brief aufrüttelt. In einem anonymen Brief hatten Lehrkräfte an einer Schule in Burg im Spreewald beklagt, sie seien täglich mit Rechtsextremismus, Sexismus und Homophobie konfrontiert. Dabei geht es um mehr als Hakenkreuze auf Möbeln, rechtsextreme Musik im Unterricht und demokratiefeindliche Parolen in den Schulfluren. Die ausländischen Schüler an der Schule erlebten Ausgrenzung, Mobbing und Gewaltandrohungen. Es herrsche das Gefühl der Machtlosigkeit und der erzwungenen Schweigsamkeit. In dem Brief ist auch von einer „Mauer des Schweigens“ die Rede. Die Lehrkräfte beklagten fehlende Unterstützung von Schulleitungen, Schulämtern und Politik

…“

Meldung vom 01.05.2023 im Migazin


 („Rechtsextremismus an Schulen oft verharmlost“), siehe weitere dazu, nicht nur in Brandenburg und nicht nur SchülerInnen:


Politische Werbung: Brandenburg erteilt AfD Schulverbot


„

Propagandamittel verfassungsfeindlicher Organisationen sind an Brandenburgs Schulen verboten, politische Werbung ohnehin. Seit die Regel auch den als erwiesen rechtsextremistisch eingestuften AfD-Landesverband trifft, sieht die Partei darin einen „Kampf gegen Andersdenkende“ und beklagt Druck auf Jugendliche.


Die rot-schwarze Brandenburger Landesregierung verbietet der AfD an Schulen die Verbreitung von Materialien und Werbemitteln. „Es ist verboten, in der Schule, auf dem Schulgelände und bei schulischen Veranstaltungen außerhalb der Schule

Kennzeichen und Propagandamittel verfassungsfeindlicher Organisationen


 mit sich zu führen, zu zeigen, weiterzugeben oder zu verteilen“, teilte das Bildungsministerium mit. „Bei Organisationen, die in einem Verfassungsschutzbericht des Bundes oder eines Landes als extremistisch benannt werden, wird die Verfassungsfeindlichkeit vermutet.“ (…)

Im Brandenburger Schulgesetz wurde im Jahr 2024 ein Paragraf ergänzt


, der ein Verbot verfassungsfeindlicher Handlungen in Schulen vorsieht. Die Schulen müssen Vorfälle zur Verherrlichung des Nationalsozialismus sowie antisemitische oder rassistische Vorfälle sofort melden. (…) Der Verfassungsschutz stuft den Landesverband der AfD als erwiesen rechtsextremistisch ein. Dies ist im

Verfassungsschutzbericht 2025


 erwähnt. Damit lägen die Voraussetzungen für den Paragrafen „Verbot verfassungsfeindlicher Handlungen“ des Schulgesetzes vor, erklärte das Bildungsministerium. Die Schulleitungen seien über den Bericht informiert worden.“


Ministerium: Keine Weisung zu politischen Botschaften


Grundsätzlich gilt das Grundrecht der Meinungsfreiheit, betonte das Ministerium. Es bestehe ein

allgemeines Verbot der politischen Werbung


 in schulischen Veranstaltungen oder auf dem Schulgelände während des Schulbetriebs. Dies solle für parteipolitische Neutralität in Schulen sorgen.

Das Ministerium wies darauf hin, dass es jedoch keine Weisung gebe, wie mit politischen Botschaften von Schülerinnen und Schülern umzugehen sei. Lehrkräfte begleiteten die Schülerinnen und Schüler,

politische Themen kritisch zu analysieren und sich ihre eigene Meinung zu bilden


. Dabei sollten sie Haltung gegenüber antidemokratischen, diskriminierenden und verfassungsfeindlichen Einstellungen, Äußerungen und Symbolen zeigen

title: KAMU-AR: Açlık sınırı 38 bin lirayı, yoksulluk sınırı 121 bin lirayı aştı
content:
Birleşik Kamu-İş Konfederasyonu'nun araştırma birimi KAMU-AR, "Açlık ve Yoksulluk Sınırı Ağustos 2026"nın sonuçlarını açıkladı. Buna göre, dört kişilik bir ailenin sağlıklı ve dengeli beslenebilmesi için yapması gereken aylık asgari gıda harcamasını gösteren açlık sınırı, ağustos ayında 102 lira artarak 38 bin 318 liraya yükseldi. Gıda harcamalarının yanı sıra barınma, ulaşım ve giyim gibi tüm zorunlu giderleri kapsayan yoksulluk sınırı ise bir önceki aya göre 3 bin 700 liralık artışla 121 bin 36 lira seviyesine ulaştı. Yıllık bazda incelendiğinde, açlık sınırında 9 bin 874 lira, gıda dışı harcamalarda 23 bin 252 lira ve genel yoksulluk sınırında 33 bin 126 lira artış kaydedildi.

Raporda, yüksek seyreden enflasyon karşısında sabit gelirli kesimin satın alma gücünün hızla eridiğine dikkat çekildi. Açlık sınırı, 28 bin 75 lira seviyesindeki net asgari ücretin 10 bin 243 lira, 23 bin 552 lira olan en düşük emekli aylığının ise 14 bin 766 lira üzerine çıktı. Bu verilere göre mevcut asgari ücret dört kişilik bir ailenin sadece 22 günlük mutfak masrafını karşılarken, en düşük emekli aylığı ise ancak 18 günlük beslenme ihtiyacına yetebildi. Aynı hanede dört kişinin asgari ücretlinin çalışması durumunda dahi elde edilen toplam gelirin yoksulluk sınırının 8 bin 736 lira gerisinde kaldığı vurgulandı. Aile ve çocuk yardımıyla birlikte 70 bin 218 lira olan en düşük memur maaşının yoksulluk sınırını karşılama oranı da yüzde 58'e geriledi.

Ankara'daki market ve pazar fiyatları temel alınarak yapılan hesaplamalara göre mutfak harcamalarında et, balık ve yumurta grubu aylık 11 bin 203 lira ile en yüksek payı oluşturdu. Kuru bakliyat harcaması 907 liraya yükselirken, süt, yoğurt ve peynir grubu harcaması 8 bin 179 lira, ekmek, un ve makarna giderleri ise 3 bin 275 lira seviyesinde gerçekleşti. Mevsimsel etkiyle birlikte taze meyve harcaması 2 bin 891 liraya, taze sebze harcaması ise 5 bin 680 liraya indi. Kalori ihtiyaçları doğrultusunda belirlenen açlık sınırı yetişkin erkek için 11 bin 188 lira, genç için 11 bin 971 lira, yetişkin kadın için 8 bin 782 lira ve çocuk için 6 bin 377 lira olarak hesaplandı.

Dört kişilik bir ailenin yoksunluk hissetmeden yaşamını sürdürebilmesi adına yapması gereken gıda dışı toplam harcama tutarı ağustosta 82 bin 718 liraya yükseldi. Gıda dışı harcamalar içinde en büyük kalemi 24 bin 788 lira ile kira dahil barınma oluştururken, ulaşım harcamaları 19 bin 761 liraya, ev eşyası giderleri 8 bin 433 liraya, giyim ve ayakkabı masrafları ise 6 bin 381 liraya ulaştı. Ailelerin sağlık, eğitim, haberleşme ve kültür harcamalarındaki artış da yoksulluk sınırının 121 bin lira barajını aşmasında belirleyici rol oynadı.
